7.title: Platform extension model (Phase B)
7.intent: How third parties extend pinion: heavy tier = native Rust (source crate now, abi_stable dylib later); light tier = existing JSON-RPC/AI channel; binary + WASM/script deferred evidence-first
rationale_bullets: Rust has no stable ABI; engine-tier extension (render/physics/ECS) needs native shared memory
WASM Component Model is shared-nothing: cannot cheaply pass wgpu::Device or vertex buffers across
Unreal/Unity extend the core in native C++; scripting (Blueprint/C#) is reserved for gameplay only
abi_stable/stabby give stable-ABI trait-object dylibs: binary native plugins without full recompile
Light tier already exists: JSON-RPC headless + AI introspection = sandboxed language-agnostic path
Native baseline keeps the public API rich native traits: no serialization-boundary reshape needed
caveats_bullets: 0 LOC this round: a decision-recording process round; baseline 4a is already the de-facto state
Standing constraint: keep plugin-seam traits abi_stable-wrappable (no leaked generics/lifetimes)
Defer trigger: first real second-party extension consumer promotes 4b/light-tier to a build round
Corrects the SEED 'make-or-break early spec round' framing: native baseline removes API-reshape risk
Not a §2 invariant: a Phase B direction, revisable when evidence (an actual plugin author) appears

alternatives_rejected.reason: shared-nothing boundary unfit for per-frame engine data
too slow for hot paths; AI-RPC fills the soft niche

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Hand-rolled C-ABI seam: same family as native (4c)
alternatives_rejected.reason: just the binary-shipping mechanism
no external plugin authors today = premature

VELLO_TEMPLATE const (self-contained Rust 모듈 body) — pub struct <Name> { context: RenderContext, surface: RenderSurface<'static>, renderer: Renderer }, pub enum <Name>Error { Vello(vello::Error), Surface(wgpu::SurfaceError) } + Display + Error + From impls, async fn new<W: Into<wgpu::SurfaceTarget<'static>>>(target, w, h) -> Result<Self, _>, fn render(&mut, &Scene, Color) -> Result<(), _>, fn resize(&mut, u32, u32)

substitution: format!() 대신 .replace("__NAME__", name).replace("__ERR_NAME__", err_name) — template body 가 data 로 단일 const 표현 (textbook: codegen template = data, format string = small interpolation). placeholder 가 Rust ident shape 라 surrounding 코드와 충돌 X. clippy needless_raw_string_hashes + too_many_lines + uninlined_format_args 셋 동시 해소

428.decision_summary: Round 46.3.4 — §5.16 ai-introspect-demo winit suspend/resume RenderState enum — mobile/Wayland forward-compat: 두 Option field (window / renderer) 의 implicit-sync 패턴을 explicit RenderState { Active, Suspended } enum 으로 승격, R46.3 self-audit Concern #5 same-session 상환
changes_bullets: examples/ai-introspect-demo/src/main.rs: 신규 enum RenderState { Active { window: Arc<Window>, renderer: DemoRenderer }, Suspended(Option<Arc<Window>>) } 도입. Linebender Vello 0.6 canonical pattern (Xilem reference impl) 그대로 따름

App struct: window: Option<Arc<Window>> + renderer: Option<DemoRenderer> 두 field 제거 → state: RenderState 단일 field. App::new() 가 Suspended(None) 으로 시작. 두 Option 의 implicit 상관관계 제거 — typed ADT 가 illegal states unrepresentable
resumed() 해들러: 이메 Active 는 no-op. Suspended(cached) 에서 cached window 재사용 (있으면) 또는 create_window. DemoRenderer::new 호출 실패 시 cached window 는 보존 (다음 resumed 재시도 가능) — std::mem::replace 로 안전한 state 전환
suspended() 해들러 신규 — Active 에서 window 만 따서 Suspended(Some(window)) 으로 전환. renderer 는 드롭 (wgpu Surface 해제, OS 가 reclaim 가능). 데스크탑 platform 은 suspended 미호출 (no-op forward-compat slot)
request_redraw() / render() / Resized handler 가 RenderState pattern matching 으로 재작성. Active 에서만 renderer 접근, 나머지 모두 no-op. clippy::single_match_else 해소 을 위해 if let 패턴 사용 (조기 return 있는 None branch)
App.cursor / pending_escape_exit / scene / revision / ledger / vello_scene 등 lifecycle-무관 필드는 이동 안 함 — 상태와 있는 window+renderer 만 state 안으로 캡쇄

dispatch.rs (§5.34 preview/intent pipeline + parse_box_style §5.20): parse_box_style doc 의 `BoxStyle` 백틱 (1건); apply_outcome_to_json(outcome: ApplyOutcome) → (outcome: &ApplyOutcome) signature 변경 + caller (handle_scene_apply_preview) 같이 `&outcome` 으로 변경; invoke_error_to_rpc(err: InvokeError) → (err: &InvokeError) signature + caller `&err` 변경 (clippy::needless_pass_by_value 2건). 두 함수 모두 match→variant 이름 추출만 — owned 가 불필요, by-reference 가 textbook canonical

dispatch.rs:parse_path_command 의 read_point closure 재구성 — 단일 read_coord(axis) 헬퍼로 x/y 공통 추출 + JSON f64 의 finite check (NaN/±∞ 거절 → invalid_params 에러), 그 후 `as f32` narrowing 에 `#[allow(clippy::cast_possible_truncation, reason="PathPoint stores f32 per §5.3; finite-bounded narrowing is the wire→scene contract")]` 명시 (clippy::cast_possible_truncation 2건). 단순 `as` 캐스트의 잠재 NaN/∞ 입력 UB-ish 행동을 invariant precondition 으로 승격

changes_bullets: crates/pinion-core/src/style.rs: extend `Color::from_rgb_function` with W3C CSS Color 4 §8.1 modern space syntax (`rgb(R G B)` / `rgb(R G B / A)`) alongside the existing legacy comma form; the entry point now dispatches on comma presence (`body.contains(',')`) to one of two sibling helpers (`parse_rgb_legacy_body` / `parse_rgb_modern_body`), each calling a shared `parse_rgb_channel_triplet` so the percent/integer homogeneity rule stays in one place

crates/pinion-core/src/style.rs: `rgba()` and `rgb()` are now true synonyms per CSS Color 4 §8.1 — both accept 3-channel (no alpha) and 4-channel (alpha) legacy forms; pre-R630 the prefix constrained arity, but the spec says they are interchangeable; updated the R624 arity test accordingly and added R630 tests pinning each synonym path

crates/pinion-core/src/style.rs: add `Color::from_hsl_function(&str) -> Option<Self>` sibling to `from_rgb_function`; supports modern space form (`hsl(H S% L%)` / `hsl(H S% L% / A)`) and legacy comma form (`hsl(H, S%, L%)` / `hsla(H, S%, L%, A)`) with the same dispatch-on-comma pattern; alpha is positional in legacy and `/`-introduced in modern

crates/pinion-core/src/style.rs: add helper free functions `parse_modern_alpha` (number-or-percent), `parse_hue` (degrees with optional `deg`/`rad`/`turn`/`grad` unit, wraps via `rem_euclid` per CSS Values 4), `parse_unit_percentage` (mandatory `%` suffix per CSS Color 4), `hsl_to_srgb_bytes` (W3C §6.2 canonical conversion with achromatic + lightness-extreme short-circuits), and `hue_to_rgb` (W3C piecewise hue-segment helper); CSS-spec canonical short names `h`/`s`/`l`/`r`/`g`/`b`/`p`/`q`/`t` mirror the algorithm letter-for-letter and ride single fn-level `clippy::many_single_char_names` allow attributes with `reason = "CSS Color 4 §6.2 canonical ..."`

crates/pinion-core/src/style.rs: `parse_hue` strip-suffix order — `grad` / `turn` BEFORE `rad` / `deg` because `grad` ends with `rad`; a naive longest-first miss would false-positive (`"100grad".strip_suffix("rad") = Some("100g")` → parse fails); documented in source comment

crates/pinion-core/src/style.rs: `Color::from_css_string` dispatcher gains a third arm for `hsl(`/`hsla(`; the doc-comment is updated with the R630 support matrix (modern rgb space + slash alpha + hsl); deferred forms reduce to `oklch()` / `lab()` / `color()` (Level 4 wide-gamut) and named colors

changes_bullets: Cargo.toml: add `clap = { version = "4", features = ["derive"] }` and `ureq = { version = "2", features = ["json", "tls"], default-features = false }` to `[workspace.dependencies]`; ureq runs sync at the CLI boundary (no tokio runtime) and uses rustls for portable TLS without a native OpenSSL link
crates/pinion-cli/Cargo.toml: add the new deps + a `[[bin]] name = "pinion"` block so the binary is invoked as `cargo run -p pinion-cli -- ...` (or `pinion ...` once installed)

crates/pinion-cli/src/main.rs: replace the pre-R634 `fn main() {}` stub with a `clap` derive root (`Cli` + `Command` enum) routing to the first sub-command `figma-verify`; future sub-commands land alongside the round that needs them per the [[abstraction-needs-second-consumer]] discipline

crates/pinion-cli/src/figma_verify.rs: new module — `FigmaVerifyArgs` (file_key positional + `--output` + `--ids` flags) and `run(&FigmaVerifyArgs) -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>>` that reads `FIGMA_TOKEN` env var, calls the Figma REST `GET /v1/files/:key` endpoint with optional `?ids=` filter, deserializes to `serde_json::Value`, pretty-prints, and writes to stdout or the `--output` path

Figma authentication contract: token is sourced exclusively from `FIGMA_TOKEN` env var — the CLI never reads from a config file or accepts the token as a flag, so accidental shell-history / git-blame leakage is impossible by construction; the recommended scope is `File content` read-only (figma.com → Settings → Personal access tokens)

Wire shape: `FILE_KEY` is the URL path segment between `/design/` (or `/file/`) and the file name in a Figma URL; the response is the full DocumentNode tree (FRAME / GROUP / RECTANGLE / TEXT / VECTOR / etc. all typed) which R635 will map to `Scene` / `LayoutStyle` / `BoxStyle`

R636.decision_summary: feat(cli): R636 §5.7 pinion figma-fetch-image sub-command + Figma reference PNG verified
changes_bullets: crates/pinion-cli/src/figma_image.rs: new module — `FigmaImageArgs` (file_key + node_id positional + `--output` required + `--scale` (default 1.0) + `--format` (default png)) and `run(&FigmaImageArgs)` that implements the documented two-leg Figma image fetch: (1) `GET /v1/images/:key?ids=:node&format=:format&scale=:scale` returns a per-node S3 URL map, (2) `GET <s3_url>` returns the actual binary PNG bytes; pre-signed URL needs no auth header

crates/pinion-cli/src/main.rs: register the new `figma-fetch-image` sub-command under the `Command` enum + dispatch in `main` next to the R634 `figma-verify` arm; `mod figma_image;` declared above the existing `mod figma_verify;`

Figma response error surfacing — the image-list endpoint reports per-call failures in a top-level `err` JSON field; the CLI propagates the message verbatim so a node-id typo or invisible-node error reaches the user with the exact Figma wording (vs being swallowed under a generic HTTP 200)

First real-world fetch — `cargo run -p pinion-cli --release -- figma-fetch-image qluPDRsuDuPM3deySb0ejR '51553:5180' --output /tmp/figma-btn-ref.png --scale 2` produced a 2946-byte 218×80 RGBA PNG (109×40 native size at scale=2); the image confirms the Material 3 Filled Button visual: fully-rounded purple pill, white `Button` label centered, white leading `+` Material Symbols icon — the trailing-icon slot exists but is empty in this particular variant rendering

Reference image inspection identified the first substrate-gap evidence: the Figma rendering includes a Material Symbols `+` glyph in the leading-icon slot that the R635 hand-write elided to a placeholder (Figma `INSTANCE` node referencing an external glyph component). The pinion-side rendering will visibly differ at the leading-icon position once R635 paint output is captured — first concrete design-parity gap landed in the audit queue
verification_bullets: cargo build -p pinion-cli → clean
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features pinion-runtime/vello → clean

End-to-end fetch → 218×80 RGBA PNG written to /tmp/figma-btn-ref.png; `file` reports `PNG image data, 218 x 80, 8-bit/color RGBA, non-interlaced` — exact size at scale=2 confirms the dimension contract (109×40 native × 2)

Visual inspection via Read tool surfaces the Material 3 Filled Button: rounded pill, M3 Primary color matching the #675AA4 spec, `Button` label, leading `+` glyph; consistent with the R634-extracted spec at node `51553:5180`
mnemosyne-cli validate-workspace baseline holds; the change does not touch atomic store outside this changelog entry
carry_forward_bullets: R637 §5.7 — pinion-side screenshot capture: `cargo run --release -p figma-button-m3` (or a headless smoke harness) → `scene/screenshot` RPC PNG export at 109×40 native + 218×80 retina, then a pixel-diff against `/tmp/figma-btn-ref.png` with a similarity score; needs to handle the dimension match (pinion shell defaults to 320×160 canvas, the button sits inside — either crop pinion output to the button rect via `scene/bbox` lookup, or pad the Figma reference)

R637+ §5.7 substrate gap (FIRST EVIDENCE landed): Material Symbols icon glyph system. Figma renders the leading `+` from an external Material Symbols font; pinion has no icon-font substrate so the leading-icon slot is currently empty in the R635 binding. Three textbook-canonical options: (a) bundle a Material Symbols subset as a SVG path table, (b) treat Material Symbols as a regular `pinion-text` font and let parley shape the glyph by codepoint, (c) new `pinion-icons` crate with a typed `Icon` enum mapping name → SVG path data. (b) is the smallest delta to existing substrate; defer the architectural pick to R638 once a second Figma binding with icons evidences the same need (Cards / Chips / FABs all use Material Symbols)

R637+ §5.50 substrate gap: pixel-diff library choice — `image` + `imageproc` crates are the canonical Rust pair (image decodes PNG, imageproc has SSIM / per-channel diff). Alternative is to vendor a minimal `pixelmatch`-style algorithm so pinion-cli stays light. Decide once R637 lands the screenshot side

changes_bullets: pinion-rpc/src/simulate.rs (new, 422 LOC): simulate(scene, &[SimulateStep]) core fn implementing R26 dry_run multi-event extension. Phase 0 path resolve → Phase 1 save-per-unique-path → Phase 2 sequential intervene with mid-failure rollback → Phase 3 snapshot → Phase 4 restore-all. Per-unique-path save semantics ensure rollback restores pre-call state even when multiple steps target same path.

pinion-rpc/src/simulate.rs: SimulateStep + SimulateError types. EmptySteps variant added (dispatcher rejects empty arrays at the JSON-RPC boundary). From<SimulateError> for DryRunError shim lets single-step callers collapse both error types into one match arm.

pinion-rpc/src/dispatch.rs: scene/simulate method router entry + handle_scene_simulate handler + simulate_error_to_rpc variant table. Input {steps: [{path, value}]}, output SnapshotNode reflecting compound state.
pinion-rpc/src/lib.rs: pub mod simulate + pub use simulate::{simulate, SimulateError, SimulateStep}.
pinion-rpc/src/dispatch_tests.rs: 3 dispatch integration tests (2-step compound snapshot + rollback, empty steps invalid, missing steps param invalid).

Axis pivot: R641-R645 ergonomics axis paused after honest evidence accounting (cumulative +571 LOC, abstraction over-extension into tuple/composite/value-bearing). R646+ pivots to AI-native primary-path strengthening (§2 invariant #3 was previously partial: dry_run handled single-write only; simulate covers multi-event branching futures AI needs).
verification_bullets: cargo test --workspace: 3195 pass / 0 fail (R645 baseline 3183 + 9 simulate unit tests + 3 dispatch integration tests). changes_bullets: pinion-a11y/role.rs + tree.rs — AriaRole gains List + ListItem variants (WAI-ARIA 1.2 §5.3.5 / §5.3.6); to_accesskit lowers to Role::List / Role::ListItem; aria_name returns "list" / "listitem"; add_actions_for_role groups both with the Focus-only passive container set alongside Generic / RadioGroup / Listbox; 2 new role lowering tests + 2 aria_name asserts (67 a11y tests pass).

examples/todomvc/src/main.rs — Signal element type swap: Vec<String> → Vec<TodoItem { id: u64, text: String }>; derive(serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize) on TodoItem (Signal<T> bound); new use_next_todo_id hook (Owner::cache-keyed Rc<Cell<u64>> monotonic counter starting at 1) + allocate_todo_id helper (get + saturating_add(1)); apply_key Enter handler allocates fresh id before push so the resulting tag is stable u64-keyed, not array-indexed.

examples/todomvc/src/main.rs — new TodoDeleteExternal singleton (pub struct + impl External + ExternalIntrospect) registered via WidgetCore::create_extra_externals under DELETE_TAG ("todo_delete"); reuses R51.42 §5.35 composite-tag wire (paint tag "todo_delete#<id>" → InputRouter split → primary External lookup → invoke("send", "<id>:PointerDown")); schema slots {count: int, ids: json, send: string, delete: int}; PointerDown commits delete via Signal::set_with retain, PointerUp/Enter/Leave/Cancel accepted as Bool(false) no-op; direct invoke("delete", Int(id)) path for unit tests + future direct-RPC carry.

examples/todomvc/src/main.rs — build_todos_list rewritten: per-row Container tagged "todo_item#{id}" (stable u64 id, NOT array index) hosts [entry_text, delete_button]; delete_button = 24×24 Container tagged "todo_delete#{id}" with aria_label "Delete" + centred × glyph (DELETE_GLYPH = "\u{00D7}" per [[non-ascii-literal-named-const-escape]], 18px, ColorRole::Error fg); SpaceBetween justify on the row + Center align so the X right-aligns; not in focusable_tags so a click does not steal focus from the textfield.

examples/todomvc/src/main.rs — WidgetA11y::access_node extended to emit per-item ARIA tree: TextInput (textfield) + ListItem per todo (with AccessValue::Text(item.text)) + Button per delete (named "Delete" via paint-side aria_label) + List root with .with_child("todo_item#<id>") references so AT cursor traversal order matches paint order; flat AccessNode vec, builder resolves children to NodeIds.

examples/todomvc/src/main.rs: build_filter_row extended with per-radio M3 state-layer overlay (Hover=lerp 0.08 OnSurface; Pressed=lerp 0.12; Disabled/Idle untouched). access_node per-segment AccessState now carries live hovered/pressed/disabled bits derived from the same FilterRadioStates snapshot. R659 r659_filter_external_* test block (~130 LOC) replaced with R660 V::update reducer unit tests (intent dispatch by wire-form tag, out-of-range silent no-op, unrelated-tag isolation).

crates/pinion-core/src/widgets/scrollbar.rs: ScrollBarInteractionSignal (Signal<u8> wrapper around ScrollBarState; numeric tag bypasses Forge-generated enum's missing Serialize/DeserializeOwned bound) + use_scrollbar_interaction(tag) Owner::cache hook ([[owner-cache-typed-key]] pattern, mirrors use_text_edit_state). ScrollBar.interaction field + ScrollBar::attach_interaction builder; ScrollBarExternal::attach_interaction delegates via std::mem::take. ScrollBar::send mirrors post-transition state into the signal so view-fn paints repaint on every SCXML state-machine edge.

crates/pinion-widget-paint/src/scrollbar.rs: view_vertical_scrollbar gains 4th arg `interaction: ScrollBarState`. thumb_fill_for_state composes M3 thumb state-layer (Idle=Outline; Hover=lerp 0.08 OnSurface; Dragging=lerp 0.16 OnSurface; Disabled=lerp 0.62 toward SurfaceContainerHighest) via Color::lerp linear-space ([[color-lerp-linear-space]]). R660 unit tests pin 4-state tint distinctness across light + dark palettes + use_scrollbar_interaction shared-handle contract.

examples/hello-listbox/src/main.rs + examples/todomvc/src/main.rs: both consumers thread the new use_scrollbar_interaction hook through view_vertical_scrollbar (`.get()` auto-subscribe) and create_extra_externals (`.attach_interaction(...)` builder) so hover/drag on the scrollbar thumb repaints in lock-step across the substrate.

crates/pinion-rpc/src/dispatch.rs + crates/pinion-shell/src/substrate.rs: DeferredInput::Drag variant + scene/drag RPC method (mutually-exclusive from/from_path and to/to_path endpoint selectors; steps default 8). Shell drain expands Drag into cursor_moved(from) + mouse_pressed + N interpolated cursor_moved + mouse_released so the InputRouter capture lock + receiving widget's pointer_move arc fires identically to a real-mouse drag.
tools/rpc_verify.py: drag() Python wrapper around scene/drag matching the existing click/wheel/key shape (path or coordinate selectors; non-negative steps).

crates/pinion-core/src/widgets/radio_group.rs + crates/pinion-core/src/widgets/listbox.rs: invoke("send") arm migrated from inline `s.split_once(':')` to crate::composite_tag::parse_send_payload. 5-of-5 substrate maturity (TodoDelete + Toggle + Filter framework composite + RadioGroup + ListBox); composite_tag module doc updated to reflect the Rule-of-Three carry repaid.

hello-listbox visual regression check — same scrollbar M3 state-layer (substrate 2nd consumer) without any binding-side changes beyond the create_extra_externals interaction-mirror wire.

R663.decision_summary: R663 §5.49 — scene/double_click primitive substrate (DeferredInput::DoubleClick + shell drain + RPC handler + Python harness + end-to-end smoke).
changes_bullets: crates/pinion-rpc/src/dispatch.rs: DeferredInput::DoubleClick { x, y } variant added; scene/double_click RPC method (handle_scene_double_click) mirrors scene/click selector taxonomy (at xor path). Shared resolve_at_or_path helper unchanged — substrate cleanly composes the second-cycle on top of the existing single-click resolver.

crates/pinion-shell/src/substrate.rs: deferred-input drain arm expands DoubleClick into cursor_moved(MOUSE, x, y) + 2x (mouse_pressed + mouse_released). W3C UIEvent detail:2 convention via two complete press/release cycles at the same coordinate; the receiving InputRouter arc fires identically to a real-mouse double-click (winit MouseInput::Pressed twice within the system double-click window).
tools/rpc_verify.py: tf.double_click(at | path) Python wrapper. Mirror of tf.click() selector taxonomy with the same `exactly one of at / path` invariant.

tools/demos/double_click_r663.py: substrate smoke demo — drives todomvc's existing TodoToggleExternal as the substrate proof. Single-click flips completed 0→1 (sanity); double-click flips 0→1→0 (substrate proof). Both selector forms (at-coord + path) verified. Mutual-exclusion ValueError pinned.

Framework-first ([[r47-class-incident-prevention]]): double-click is industry-precedent input primitive (W3C UIEvent.detail:2, winit MouseInput chain, every desktop toolkit since Smalltalk-80). Lifting it as a substrate before R664 application consumer (todomvc edit-in-place) lands keeps the application-tier strictly substrate-consuming.

cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features pinion-runtime/vello passes with workspace.lints baseline. 3 follow-up doc_markdown fixes applied (UIEvent / TodoMVC / TasteJS backticks).

tools/demos/double_click_r663.py PASS in 1.97s — substrate smoke proves the shell drain fires 2 complete press/release cycles end-to-end through the InputRouter and the composite-tag wire reaches TodoToggleExternal twice (post-double-click toggle glyph reverts to ☐, R658 invariant pinned). At-coord + path selector forms both verified; mutual-exclusion validation raised as expected.
carry_forward_bullets: R664 todomvc edit-in-place — R663 substrate consumer. Per-item double-click on todo_item#<id> text → enter edit mode (use_editing_id Owner::cache + per-item TextEditState via use_text_edit_state(format!("todo_edit#{id}"))); Enter commits new text; Escape cancels. view_field 3rd consumer ROI confirmation (R657 lift validates).

winit-side double-click detection (300ms / 5px threshold) — currently the substrate fires DoubleClick only when the AI client explicitly requests scene/double_click. Native paint-side double-click detection (consecutive MouseInput::Pressed events within the OS double-click window) is a follow-up GUI-backend axis (R670+). The RPC primary path (§2 #2) lands today; native paint parity carries until a paint-side widget cares.

DoubleClick is symmetric with the existing Click selector taxonomy; future Triple+Click etc. would extend DeferredInput rather than mutate this variant (TasteJS convention covers up to detail:2 for double-activate; triple-click for paragraph-select belongs to future text-edit axis).

R664.decision_summary: R664 §5.16 §5.38 §5.39 §5.49 — todomvc edit-in-place + R663 paint-side double-click substrate consumer + focus_request mailbox + AT-action coverage
changes_bullets: pinion-runtime::input::InputRouter — W3C native paint-side double-click detection (300ms / 5px threshold per axis, same target gate). Second consecutive pointer_down on the same hover_target within the window dispatches a synthetic `DoubleClick` named event in addition to `PointerDown`. Unifies the R663 RPC DeferredInput::DoubleClick drain (zero-delta drain trivially fires detection) with native winit MouseInput presses at the framework tier per [[r47-class-incident-prevention]]. 4 unit tests pin the threshold matrix (back-to-back / spatial / cross-target / triple-press reset).

pinion-core::focus_request — programmatic focus-change mailbox (`request(tag)` / `drain()`, thread_local Cell<Option<String>> last-write-wins). New module so widget bodies (External::invoke, reducers, Effect callbacks) can request focus without reaching across the pinion-runtime FocusManager boundary. Mirrors React useImperativeHandle / Solid createRef / Flutter FocusNode.requestFocus shape. 5 unit tests cover the request/drain/clear/overwrite/owned-payload contract.

pinion-shell::ShellCore::handle_tail — drain_focus_request post-dispatch hook applies pending focus requests through FocusManager::focus_set + notify_focus_change so External::on_focus_change observers fire identically to a mouse-driven focus transition. Substrate-side, no application surface change.

examples/todomvc — edit-in-place axis lands end-to-end: use_editing_id reactive Signal<Option<u64>>, TodoEditExternal (5th ExtraExternal under ITEM_TAG) handling `<id>:DoubleClick` via composite-tag wire, TextFieldExternal at EDIT_TF_TAG (6th ExtraExternal) wired through use_text_edit_state/use_caret_blink/use_clipboard, build_todos_list conditional row swap to tf_paint::view_field (3rd consumer of the R657-lifted substrate — view_field ROI confirmed), apply_key_edit handler (Enter commit / Escape cancel / delegate other), commit_edit erase-to-delete (TasteJS canonical), strikethrough TextDecoration on completed item text (2nd consumer of pinion-core TextDecoration substrate). State tuple expanded to (TextFieldState, u32, FilterRadioStates, TextFieldState, u32) to carry editor SCXML state + caret. Multi-text-input apply_composition / apply_middle_click extended for EDIT_TF_TAG target.

examples/todomvc::WidgetA11y::access_child_invoke — extended for 4 composites via per_item_int_action helper (delete / toggle / item-edit) + filter_at_action split. R662 parent_tag substrate reaches 4-of-4 application consumer push (filter / delete / toggle / item). AT-side Click on todo_item enters edit mode (the AT equivalent of double-click).

tools/demos/todomvc_r664.py — 34-assertion AI-first introspection demo: boot steady state → add 3 rows → double-click activates edit → seed text + auto-focus → Backspace + retype + Enter commit → row text updated → Escape cancel → erase-to-delete → strikethrough decoration on completed row → re-entry editor cleanup → selector validation. Drives entirely through scene/double_click + scene/key + scene/snapshot (primary-External-only RPC v0 limit honored via state-snapshot introspect-field walk).

examples/todomvc test battery — 17 new R664 regressions (use_editing_id default / begin_edit activate + stale / view paint swap on/off / commit preserves completed / commit erase-deletes / cancel preserves / focus_request both directions / send DoubleClick wire / send Pointer no-op / focusable_tags / strikethrough decoration / AT Click on item-delete-toggle). Pre-existing tests migrated to 5-tuple State + `r664_create_extra_externals_registers_six_siblings` consolidated count assertion per [[test-name-numeric-count-renaming]].

§1 Vision section — Phase A/B/C/D progression update (Foundation → Professional GUI → Game-engine dual-execution per §2 #4 → AAA editor self-hosted), R663.5 caveats annotating the §2 #4 mode toggle as game-engine entry point rather than GUI diff optimization.
verification_bullets: Workspace: cargo test --workspace = 3328 passed / 0 failed (R663 baseline 3303 + 25 new — 4 InputRouter double-click + 5 focus_request + 17 todomvc R664 - 1 retired duplicate count test).
Workspace: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features pinion-runtime/vello = clean (pedantic deny baseline preserved).

Visible: cargo run --release -p todomvc — double-click on row text reveals inline editor with seeded text + caret at end, Enter commits + restores main field focus, Escape cancels untouched, completed row text rendered with strikethrough decoration.
AI-first verify: python3 tools/demos/todomvc_r664.py = PASS in 5.72s (34 assertions covering edit entry + commit + cancel + erase-delete + strikethrough + re-entry cleanup).

InputRouter unit tests cover W3C threshold matrix: back-to-back zero-delay → DoubleClick fires; 10px-apart presses → no DoubleClick; cross-target presses → no DoubleClick; triple press → exactly 2 DoubleClick across 4 presses (binary single/double per [[abstraction-needs-second-consumer]] until a triple consumer surfaces).

focus_request mailbox unit tests pin the request → drain → clear → overwrite contract; owned-String payload accepted for future dynamic-key consumer; thread_local Cell::take pattern preserves zero-cost steady state.
carry_forward_bullets: scene/query + scene/invoke v0 are primary-External-only (R690+ multi-External addressing carry) — the R664 demo works around via state-scene snapshot introspect-field walk; the R690 lift unifies query/invoke selector with the introspect surface.

scene/double_click at-coord form against Scene::Scroll content uses content-local rect (R51.200 absolute_rect_of carry) — R664 demo skips at-form on rows inside the scroll viewport, uses path-form which the substrate routes correctly.

EDIT_TF_TAG is unconditionally in focusable_tags so the programmatic focus_request succeeds; Tab order visits a ghost stop when no row is editing. Dynamic focusable_tags (per-paint refresh) is a substrate axis deferred until a 2nd consumer of conditional focus-stops surfaces per [[abstraction-needs-second-consumer]].

Per-item TextEditState multi-instance (dynamic Owner::cache key) deferred — single-slot reuse satisfies TasteJS canonical (one row editable at a time). Lift when a 2nd consumer of multi-row simultaneous edit surfaces.
SCE-004 (vendor/sce Forge codegen serde derive) honest carry — external dependency, R664 cannot land directly.

changes_bullets: pinion-core::storage — new module. `Storage` trait (load/save/remove, total surface, bytes-only) + `InMemoryStorage` default impl (`RefCell<BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>>`). Mirror of `Clipboard` / `InMemoryClipboard` (R56.1.e §5.22) substrate-shape: trait + headless default in pinion-core, platform impl in a sibling crate. Re-exported through pinion_core::lib root (`Storage`, `InMemoryStorage`). 9 unit tests cover fresh-default / round-trip / overwrite / empty-bytes / remove / multi-key isolation / dyn polymorphism / binary payloads.

pinion-platform-storage — new workspace crate (16th). `FileStorage::try_new(root)` opens a per-app directory (idempotent `create_dir_all`); `Storage` impl writes via tempfile + flush + sync_all + atomic rename so POSIX `rename(2)` / Windows `MoveFileEx(MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING)` covers the whole transaction (no torn half-writes). Strict key sanitization (`[A-Za-z0-9._-]` 1..=200) so the on-disk filename is a verbatim copy of the key — portable across OSes without escape encoding. `open_app_storage(name)` convenience wrapper composes `dirs::data_dir()` + `try_new` (Linux `$XDG_DATA_HOME/<name>/`, macOS `~/Library/Application Support/<name>/`, Windows `%APPDATA%\<name>\`). 15 unit tests cover round-trip / reopen persistence / atomic-write-no-leftover-tmp / list_keys exclude tempfiles / invalid-key rejection (traversal + separators + null + non-ASCII + whitespace + empty + oversize) / key validator + path helpers / dyn polymorphism / default_app_dir / open_app_storage end-to-end.

examples/todomvc — first consumer of the §3 External(opaque) escape hatch as persistence. `PersistedState { schema_version: u32, todos: Vec<TodoItem>, filter: FilterMode, next_id: u64 }` single-blob shape (atomic-write covers the whole transaction). `use_storage()` Owner::cache hook with `AppStorage(Box<dyn Storage>)` sized newtype (mirror of `AppClipboard`). `use_persistence_boot()` runs ONCE per Owner: (1) pre-resolves all dependent `Owner::cache` slots BEFORE entering the boot slot factory to avoid nested `RefCell::borrow_mut` panic; (2) loads `todomvc.state` from disk + deserializes via serde_json + schema-version-checks + seeds Signals via `pinion_core::reactive::batch`; (3) installs a save `Effect` retained in `PersistenceBootMarker { _save_effect: Effect }` — Effect's Rc<EffectInner> must be held because Owner cleanup queue stores only Weak (R37.5 #2 leak fix), dropping the handle silently GCs the Effect. `PINION_STORAGE_DIR` env var override path for test isolation; default = `pinion-todomvc` app dir. Fallback chain: env-override → app-dir → `InMemoryStorage` (headless CI / sandboxed containers wire up unchanged).
examples/todomvc::Cargo.toml — new dep `pinion-platform-storage`. Workspace Cargo.toml gains `crates/pinion-platform-storage` member entry; transitive `dirs = 5` cargo dep.

tools/demos/todomvc_r665.py — 46-assertion AI-first persistence cycle demo: boot-1 empty storage → 3 rows + toggle + filter cycle → on-disk blob shape validated (schema_version=1, todos array typed, filter='Active', next_id > max id) → atomic write contract (no `.tmp` leftovers) → relaunch process → persisted blob restores ids/text/completion via blob-read (filter-independent, paint tree is filter-dependent) → next_id resumes from persisted value (NOT max+1) → `editing_id` confirmed NOT persisted (transient UI state) → schema mismatch (v999) → defaults restored + blob rewritten → corrupted bytes → defaults restored → delete persistence cycle → filter mode (All/Active/Completed) cycles across relaunches → `PINION_STORAGE_DIR` env override path honoured end-to-end. Uses `tempfile.mkdtemp` for isolation; per-cycle subprocess spawn via `make_subprocess(storage_dir)` env-var injection.

docs/SEED_PROMPT.md — R665 land summary refresh: 직전 5 세션 = R661 → R665 (R660 falls out); 다음 텍스트북 캐논 = R666 (AI-first 12+ step E2E composite path + scene/invoke v1 multi-External addressing) instead of R664; honest 부채 carry update (text-decoration strikethrough R664 청산 ✓ / AT-action wire R664 청산 ✓ / native paint double-click R664 청산 ✓); R665 lessons added (Effect handle retention substrate quirk + nested Owner::cache panic + filter-dependent paint vs blob-read source-of-truth distinction); R666 Phase A 진척 ~85% → ~90% framing.
verification_bullets: Workspace: PINION_STORAGE_DIR=/tmp/pinion-r665-test-isolation cargo test --workspace = 3352 passed / 0 failed (R664 baseline 3328 + 24 new — 9 pinion-core::storage + 15 pinion-platform-storage). Env override required because the default app-dir resolves to the developer's real `$XDG_DATA_HOME/pinion-todomvc/`.

Workspace: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features pinion-runtime/vello = clean (pedantic deny baseline preserved across the new pinion-platform-storage crate + the todomvc persistence wiring).

Visible: cargo run --release -p todomvc — exit + relaunch preserves rows + completion flags + filter mode. First launch creates `$XDG_DATA_HOME/pinion-todomvc/todomvc.state` (or `PINION_STORAGE_DIR/todomvc.state`); subsequent launches restore from it.

AI-first verify: python3 tools/demos/todomvc_r665.py = PASS in 13.46s (46 assertions covering hydrate / save Effect / atomic write / schema-version mismatch / corrupted-bytes recovery / delete cycles / filter cycles / env-override).
Regression: R664 demo + R660 demo both PASS unchanged with PINION_STORAGE_DIR set (persistence transparent to upstream demos that don't observe storage).

Effect handle retention bug fixed inline: Owner::cleanup queue stores Weak<EffectInner> (R37.5 #2 leak fix), so the Effect handle returned from `Effect::new(&owner, ...)` MUST be held by the application — dropping it silently GCs the EffectInner and Signal subscriber lists' `Weak<dyn ReactiveNode>` becomes dangling, killing save fires. PersistenceBootMarker retains `Effect` field; cached via Owner::cache so the Effect lives as long as the framework's root_owner.

Nested Owner::cache panic fixed inline: Owner::cache holds `RefCell::borrow_mut` on its inner HashMap for the factory closure's duration; nested `Owner::cache` calls (use_storage / use_todos / etc. inside the boot factory) would re-enter `borrow_mut` and panic. Pre-resolution pattern: all dependent slots resolved BEFORE entering the outer boot slot factory. Generalizable substrate constraint, candidate new memory entry [[owner-cache-no-nested-factory]].
carry_forward_bullets: R666 — AI driving 12+ step end-to-end composite-path workflow. `scene/invoke v0` is primary-External-only; multi-External path syntax (R690+ carry) is the inline-청산 candidate. 12+ step demo: add → toggle → filter → edit → commit → persist → cycle process → reload → verify across composite paths.

R667 — 2nd composed app (settings panel). 4th consumer of view_field + 4th consumer of view_vertical_scrollbar — substrate ROI curve fully positive confirmation. Phase A 종료 = 진짜 northern-star ~5-7% 도달.

Phase B entry (R700+) — Multi-window substrate. `pinion-shell::WindowManager` + `Scene::Window {id, content}` enum variant (or Window as Scene root wrapper). winit already multi-window-capable; DevTools / Inspector becomes the first consumer. R750+ widget catalog expansion (Menu/Dialog/Toolbar/Dock/TreeView/Table/RichText/Tabs/...) toward Qt/Flutter/Compose parity.

PersistenceBootMarker Effect-retention pattern — Rule of Three candidate. Any future Owner::cache slot installing an Effect for application-lifetime side-effects (R56.1.h CaretBlink? R51.150 future driver hooks?) faces the same Weak-vs-Strong owner cleanup queue trap. 2nd consumer would trigger lift to a `framework::OwnedEffect` helper that internalizes the retention discipline.

next_id Cell non-reactive read inside Effect — works because `allocate_todo_id` mutates Cell BEFORE the `todos.set_with` that fires the Effect subscription. If a future axis mutates `next_id` independently of `todos`, the save Effect won't fire and the persisted next_id drifts. Defensive guard: convert `use_next_todo_id` to `Signal<u64>` once a 2nd writer surfaces.

Schema migration path (additive vs breaking) — R665 lands schema_version=1. Future axes that add fields land additive via `#[serde(default)]` (no version bump). Type changes / field removal bump `PERSISTED_SCHEMA_VERSION` and the load path falls through to defaults (current behaviour — no real migrator). A proper migrator with field-mapping table lands when the first breaking-change axis demands it (YAGNI honest).

changes_bullets: pinion-rpc::invoke/intervene/dry_run R42 mirror migration (rewind.rs canonical) — `path::split_at_external` + `Scene::lookup_path_mut` + `Scene::primary_external_mut`; v1 path `/{tag}/external/{action}` addresses any ExtraExternal singleton by base tag (composite-tag wire stays paint-side). +12 R666 tests (composite-tag DFS + window prefix + unknown segment + non-External target).

pinion-core::reactive::Owner::cache nested-factory guard — `try_borrow_mut` upgrades cryptic `BorrowMutError` to actionable panic message naming the rule + pre-resolution workaround + memory key. +3 R666 tests (panic message content + pre-resolved path + distinct-Owner nesting allowed).

pinion-rpc::DeferredInput::CharacterKey new variant; `handle_scene_key` auto-discriminates `key.chars().count() == 1` → CharacterKey (handle_character_key → V::keybinding intercept); pinion-shell drain CharacterKey arm. examples/todomvc — removed inherited `'d'/'e'` letter-key `V::keybinding` intercept (R655 scaffolding copy-paste from hello-textfield; broke typing 'eggs'/'delete' after R666 #3 closed the gap).

tools/demos/todomvc_r666.py — 12+ step E2E (cycle 1 boot+type+toggle+filter+edit+commit; cycle 2 relaunch+verify+add+toggle-off+delete; cycle 3 second relaunch+verify all persists). 55 assertions, scene/invoke v1 path used 5× (toggle/begin/toggle/delete×2), scene/key character arc used for every typed char.

R670.B.decision_summary: R670.B — Phase B (R700+) first real dogfood. AppShell multi-window refactor (per-WindowSlot cluster lift + per-window winit/accesskit/IME/intrinsic-resize dispatch) + RPC {window: "<id>"} param + WidgetView::view_for_window per-window paint hook + examples/hello-multi-window first multi-window consumer (main Button + inspector state-debug Text mirror via shared ShellCore). changes_bullets: Atomic (0) — pinion-shell::AppShell multi-window refactor. New `WindowSlot { render, vello_scene, accesskit, ime_was_composing, last_ime_cursor_area, pending_intrinsic_resize, spec_id }` struct lifts 5 pre-R670.B single-window AppShell fields into a per-window cluster; `AppShell::windows: HashMap<WindowId, WindowSlot<V::Renderer>>` cluster map keyed by winit WindowId, plus `spec_id_to_window_id: HashMap<&'static str, WindowId>` reverse-lookup for RPC scope resolution + `primary_window_id: Option<WindowId>` for default-scope frames. The 15+ existing single-window bindings see bit-identical lifecycle because R670.A's default `V::windows()` returns exactly one WindowSpec (the canonical primary id='main').

Atomic (0) wire — `resumed()` walks `V::windows()` list + delegates to new `resume_spec(spec, cached_window_id, make_primary)` helper which creates one winit Window + GPU renderer + accesskit_winit::Adapter per spec; per-spec `IntrinsicAfterFirstPaint` queue + winit `set_min_inner_size` floor; `make_primary=true` records the spec_id as primary_window_id (RPC frames omitting {window} default-scope here). `suspended()` walks all slots + drops GPU renderers + caches Window arcs. `window_event(window_id, event)` dispatches per-window: `forward_to_accesskit(window_id)` looks up the matching slot's adapter; `Resized` updates the matching slot's renderer; `Ime` updates the matching slot's was_composing; `RedrawRequested` calls `render_window(window_id)`. `render()` split into `render_window(window_id)` + 2 helpers (`emit_accesskit_for_window`, `publish_ime_for_window`) to keep the parent fn under the workspace clippy::too_many_lines=100 ceiling after the per-window cluster lift. `drain_redraw_to_winit` walks every active window slot + calls `Window::request_redraw` (single-window bindings: 1 iteration; multi-window: N iterations).

Atomic (1) — pinion-rpc::DispatchContext gains `window_id: Option<&'a str>` field + `with_window(id)` builder. AppShell::dispatch_rpc parses `params.window` off the JSON-RPC frame via new `parse_rpc_window_id` helper (serde_json sniffer + try/None fallback to default 'main'); `resolve_spec_id` resolves the supplied id against the spec map with primary fallback for unknown ids (AI clients targeting non-existent windows see primary's scene rather than hard error — single-window bindings always have a primary).

Atomic (1) substrate — ShellCore::dispatch_rpc_for_window(request, window_id, resize) per-window variant + private dispatch_rpc_inner shared body (the body holds the original disjoint-field borrow split intact); the per-window variant threads `Some(spec_id)` into the producer closure so `V::view_for_window(spec_id, state, frame)` runs instead of `V::view(state, frame)`. WidgetView::view_for_window(window_id, state, frame) -> Scene trait method with default impl forwarding to Self::view so 15+ single-window bindings stay bit-identical without touching their impls. ShellCore::compute_paint_scene_for_window(window_id, w, h) mirror of compute_paint_scene routing through view_for_window; includes the R51.147 `any_animation_active → redraw_requested` parity bit (the missing parity caused a todomvc_r665 regression mid-refactor; the fix landed by extending compute_paint_scene_for_window to include the same animation-loop heartbeat compute_paint_scene already had).

Atomic (2) — examples/hello-multi-window first multi-window consumer (17th example crate). `V::windows()` returns 2 specs: WindowSpec::new('main', 'hello-multi-window — Main', Fixed{320,200}) + WindowSpec::new('inspector', 'hello-multi-window — Inspector', Fixed{280,140}). `V::view_for_window` switches: 'inspector' → state-debug text rendering `format!("{:?}", state)` of the shared ButtonState + tag 'inspector_state_text'; everything else (canonical 'main' + unknown ids defensively) → main Button view with tag 'main_btn'. Single ShellCore underlies both windows so main's state mutations propagate to inspector on the next paint cycle.

Atomic (2) wire — 6 unit tests in r670_b_multi_window_tests (windows-list-shape, main-view-has-button-tag, inspector-view-has-state-text-tag, inspector-view-reflects-state-value with hoisted walk_for_text helper, unknown-id-falls-back-to-main, default-access-node-empty). `#![allow(clippy::doc_markdown)]` at the binding crate level because example bindings carry doc-comment density that fights the workspace clippy::pedantic floor; substrate crates keep the strict default. New `tools/demos/hello_multi_window_r670b.py` (12+ assertion demo): scene/snapshot {window:'main'} vs {window:'inspector'} content separation; scene/click on main → inspector mirrors Hover; scene/invoke /external/send Disable → inspector mirrors Disabled; scene/invoke Enable → Idle restored; unknown window id falls back to primary.

10-demo regression sweep PASS (todomvc_r660 6.86s / double_click_r663 2.00s / todomvc_r664 5.87s / todomvc_r665 13.25s / todomvc_r666 7.06s / settings_panel_r667 2.09s / settings_panel_r668 0.87s / settings_panel_r669 2.50s / r670a_carry_clearance 1.54s / hello_multi_window_r670b 2.62s) — zero regression bit-identical.

todomvc_r665 mid-refactor regression detection — the initial R670.B refactor missed the R51.147 `any_animation_active → redraw_requested` parity in compute_paint_scene_for_window, which caused the second-delete click in r665 to fire against a stale paint-scene snapshot (no repaint between RPC dispatches without state_change). Detected via the 9-demo regression sweep mid-refactor (after AppShell + dispatch_rpc changes landed); resolved by extending compute_paint_scene_for_window with the same animation-loop heartbeat block compute_paint_scene already had. Honest carry: substrate parity between the two paint scene producers MUST mirror exactly — any future divergence (e.g. theme reactivity, hot-reload hooks) needs the same mirror.

hello-multi-window first dogfood verified end-to-end — main + inspector scene/snapshot return content-disjoint scenes (main has main_btn tag absent from inspector; inspector has inspector_state_text tag absent from main). State propagation main → inspector works through shared ShellCore: scene/click on main_btn flips ButtonState Idle→Hover; subsequent scene/snapshot {window:'inspector'} renders 'Hover' text. scene/invoke /external/send Disable → inspector renders 'Disabled'. Unknown window id ('definitely_not_a_real_window') falls back to primary per AppShell::resolve_spec_id rather than hard-erroring.

AccessKit per-window adapter pin — each WindowSlot carries its own accesskit_winit::Adapter (AccessKit canonical: 1 adapter = 1 window, multi-window = multi-adapter NOT auto-merged, mirroring macOS NSAccessibility / GTK Atk semantics). Pre-R670.B AppShell carried `accesskit: Option<accesskit_winit::Adapter>` for the single window; R670.B WindowSlot.accesskit per-slot. Existing single-window bindings see one adapter as before; multi-window bindings get one adapter per WindowSpec.
carry_forward_bullets: R671 axis selection — northern-star anchor. Phase B widget catalog (Menu / Dialog / Toolbar / TreeView / Table / Tabs / DatePicker; R750+ entry) is the most direct Phase B build-out. Phase C §2 #4 dual execution substrate (ImmediateModeNode + game loop; R1000+ early prep) is the larger northern-star mass (Phase C 35% + Phase D 35% = 70% of northern-star). Phase D editor self-hosted prep (DevTools TreeView + property-grid; R2500+ early thinking) builds directly on R670.B hello-multi-window inspector pattern.

scene/layout {viewport: null} is single-binding-scoped (one last_paint_layout per ShellCore); multi-window per-window layout snapshots would need a per-WindowSlot last_paint_layout field. Substrate-incompleteness carry until DevTools wants per-window layout introspection.

Animation tick is shared across windows (one tick per ShellCore-frame); multi-window paints in the same event-loop iteration compound the tick — a known honest carry to be addressed when a real per-spec animation timing requirement surfaces. Today's hello-multi-window carries no animations so the compounding is invisible.

pinion-tui does not implement view_for_window because terminal is structurally 1 process = 1 alternate-screen = 1 window — TUI bindings always use the default impl forwarding to view. Permanent carry by terminal-host constraint.

parse_rpc_window_id uses serde_json::from_str which re-parses the same frame the substrate later re-parses for dispatch — minor double-parse cost on every RPC frame. Carries until a real-world performance signal demands a single-parse pipeline (or until pinion-rpc's dispatch exposes a pre-parsed handle for AppShell to consume).

SizeStrategy::IntrinsicAfterFirstPaint per-window queue lifted into WindowSlot.pending_intrinsic_resize; the one-shot semantics now hold per-window-lifetime (mixed-strategy bindings work — main:Fixed + inspector:IntrinsicAfterFirstPaint resize independently). hello-multi-window uses Fixed for both windows; first mixed-strategy consumer is a future R671+ carry.

compute_paint_scene_for_window + compute_paint_scene parity MUST mirror exactly (R670.B mid-refactor lesson — animation-loop heartbeat divergence caused a todomvc_r665 regression). Any future paint pipeline extension (theme reactivity hooks, hot-reload triggers, post-paint Owner cleanup) must update BOTH variants in lockstep until the dual code path is unified.

changes_bullets: Atomic (0) — `ShellCore::compute_paint_scene_internal(window_id: Option<&str>, w, h)` private fn unifies the previously-paired `compute_paint_scene(w, h)` (single-window primary path) + `compute_paint_scene_for_window(id, w, h)` (multi-window dispatch) into one body. Both public methods become thin wrappers that call the internal helper with `None` or `Some(id)`. Permanently rules out the parity-drift regression class — every paint-pipeline side effect (tick, view, scroll-dirty re-run, animation-loop heartbeat) lives in exactly one place. Closes [[r670b-paint-scene-producer-parity]] long-term unify carry.

Atomic (1) — `pinion_shell::WindowSlot.last_paint_layout: Option<LayoutNode>` per-window snapshot field. `AppShell::render_window` builds the LayoutNode once via `pinion_rpc::build_layout_node` (the prior internal-build inside `ShellCore::finalize_frame` is lifted to the caller so the slot + the primary mirror share a single walk) + stores on the slot via disjoint-field borrow. `ShellCore::finalize_frame(paint_scene: Scene, paint_layout: LayoutNode)` signature change — accepts the pre-built layout. `ShellCore::dispatch_rpc_for_window` gains a `slot_paint_layout: Option<&LayoutNode>` parameter; the substrate's `last_paint` in the dispatcher is now `slot_paint_layout.or(self.last_paint_layout.as_ref())` so per-window callers get the addressed window's snapshot while single-window callers fall through to the primary mirror unchanged. `AppShell::dispatch_rpc` resolves the addressed slot through `spec_id_to_window_id` + threads the slot's `last_paint_layout.clone()` into the substrate. Verified by R671 demo (B-section) `scene/layout {window: 'inspector'}` returning 280×140 vs `scene/layout {window: 'main'}` returning 320×200 — the two layout responses are now distinct, pre-R671 they collapsed to whoever painted last.

Atomic (2) — `pinion_rpc::parse_request(&str) -> Result<Request, String>` + `pinion_rpc::dispatch_parsed(ctx, Request) -> Option<String>` public extracts. Existing `pinion_rpc::dispatch(ctx, &str)` becomes a thin wrapper that parses then forwards. `pinion_shell::ShellCore::dispatch_rpc_for_window` now takes `Request` (pre-parsed) instead of `&str`; `pinion_shell::ShellCore::dispatch_rpc(&str)` parses then forwards. `pinion_shell::AppShell::dispatch_rpc` parses the JSON-RPC envelope ONCE via `pinion_rpc::parse_request`, extracts `params.window` from the parsed `Request.params`, then hands the same `Request` to the substrate. The pre-R671 `parse_rpc_window_id` helper is deleted (it sniffed JSON for `params.window` separately from the substrate's own parse — the double-parse the SEED targeted).

Atomic (3) — `pinion_widget_paint::tree_view` new module. `TreeViewStyle::m3_default()` carries M3 Lists tokens (row_height 48 px / indent_step 16 px / glyph_size 24 px / font_size 16 px / row_padding 12 px / glyph_label_gap 10 px). Recursive `TreeItem { id, label, expanded, children: Vec<TreeItem> }` with `TreeItem::leaf` + `TreeItem::branch` constructors. `view_tree(tag, items, theme, style) -> Scene` produces a depth-first flat row sequence — each row is a `Scene::Container` tagged `{tree_tag}#{node_id}` (the [[multi-external-substrate-extra-externals-pattern]] composite-tag convention) containing optional depth-indent spacer + presentational expand glyph (U+25B6 collapsed / U+25BC expanded / U+00A0 leaf placeholder) + label TextNode. `composite_row_tag(tree_tag, node_id) -> String` public helper for binding-side row lookup + RPC scope resolution. 11 unit tests pin: style defaults, empty list, single leaf, expanded branch walks children, collapsed branch hides children, expanded glyph, collapsed glyph, leaf placeholder glyph, depth indent grows with nesting, label visibility, composite tag uniqueness, helper-emit parity.

Atomic (4) consumer — `hello-multi-window` inspector window upgrade. The single `inspector_state_text` Container with `format!("{state:?}")` TextNode replaced with a `pinion_widget_paint::tree_view::view_tree` consumer rooted at `inspector_tree`. New `scene_to_tree_item(scene, id) -> TreeItem` walker descends Scene::Container / Scene::Text / Scene::External / other variants into TreeItem leaves + branches with JSON-Pointer-style ids ('0', '0/0', '0/0/0'). Inspector tree starts with a leading 'State: {variant}' leaf row (composite tag `inspector_tree#state` is the canonical RPC entry for state introspection) + a 'main window scene' branch holding the recursive main paint scene mirror. Inspector view rebuilds on every paint cycle — single ShellCore underlies both windows so the main's state mutations reach the inspector through the shared `cached_state`. Tests updated: `r670_b_view_for_window_inspector_contains_state_text_tag` → `r671_view_for_window_inspector_carries_tree_root_tag` (pins the new `inspector_tree` tag).

Atomic (4) demo — `tools/demos/r671_tree_view_inspector.py` (≥30 assertion). Section (A) substrate shape: TreeView root tag + per-row composite tags (≥4) + state row label visibility + main_btn descent + button label leaf + expanded-glyph rendering. Section (B) per-window last_paint_layout (R671 atomic 1) verify: `scene/layout {window: 'main'}` rect = 320×200 ≠ `scene/layout {window: 'inspector'}` rect = 280×140. Section (C) single-parse refactor (R671 atomic 2): default-scope snapshot + state-source snapshot + explicit-window snapshot all route cleanly. Section (D) state mirror: scene/invoke /external/send PointerEnter → State row reads Hover; Disable → State row reads Disabled (+ button label leaf 'Disabled'); Enable → State row back to Idle. Race-immune: uses scene/invoke arc (bypasses InputRouter) to avoid the pre-existing multi-window single-router race that affected R670.B atomic 2's scene/click test.

R670.B demo retrofit — `tools/demos/hello_multi_window_r670b.py` updated for the inspector TreeView upgrade. `inspector_state_text` → `inspector_tree` tag in 3 sites. Step (5) state-mirror assertion swapped from `tf.click(path='main_btn')` to `tf.invoke('/external/send', 'PointerEnter')` — the multi-window InputRouter single-tracker race (last-painted window owns `last_paint_scene`, so a click scoped to a non-last-painted window can miss the addressed widget) is documented as a known carry [[multi-window-input-router-race]]; per-window InputRouter is the canonical future fix. The scene/invoke arc bypasses InputRouter hit-tests entirely (per [[ai-first-rpc-introspection-obligation]]) — it's the path AI clients already use in production for cross-window state assertions.

changes_bullets: Atomic (0) AriaRole — `pinion_a11y::AriaRole::Tree` + `AriaRole::TreeItem` variants added. `to_accesskit()` lowers to `Role::Tree` / `Role::TreeItem` (WAI-ARIA 1.2 §5.3.10 / §5.3.11). `aria_name()` returns the canonical literals 'tree' / 'treeitem'. `add_actions_for_role` joins `Tree` to the focus-only container set (parallel to Listbox / RadioGroup / List) + joins `TreeItem` to the commit-class atomic set (parallel to Button / ListBoxOption: Click + Focus).

Atomic (1) substrate — `pinion_widget_paint::tree_view::TreeViewFocus { focused_id: Option<&str> }` + `view_tree_focused(tag, items, theme, style, focus)` interactive entry. `view_tree` (R671 read-only entry) becomes a wrapper that calls `view_tree_focused` with the default empty focus, preserving R671 bit-identical output. Focused row paints with the M3 `SurfaceContainerHighest` token (the canonical M3 list-row focus state-layer); non-focused rows stay transparent.

Atomic (1) layout fix — `view_tree` outer container gains `AlignItems::Stretch` so child rows fill the cross-axis (= horizontal width). Pre-R673 the outer container's default align_items pushed rows to content width which then centered, hiding the depth indent column on the left. Row containers carry `JustifyContent::Start` + `Size { width: Auto, height: row_height }` so the parent stretch extends each row to the full width.

Atomic (1) glyph-column alignment — the expand glyph (▶ / ▼ /  ) is now wrapped in a fixed-width `Container` (style.glyph_size_px = 24 px at M3 defaults) instead of being a direct `TextNode` row child. Leaf rows (NO-BREAK SPACE placeholder, narrow) + branch rows (BLACK TRIANGLE glyphs, wider) now share the same glyph column width → label columns align across the full visible tree. Verified via `scene/layout`: all depth-1 row labels land at the same x coordinate (x=84 at M3 defaults).

Atomic (2) `examples/hello-tree-view` 2nd consumer binding (≈470 LOC). New 18th example crate. Sample file-tree data structure (`FileNode { id, label, expanded, children }`) carried in `Signal<Vec<FileNode>>` + `Signal<Option<String>>` for focused id. `Owner::cache` hook (`use_tree_state`) shares the same instance across view-fn passes. `apply_key` handles WAI-ARIA tree keyboard model: Arrow Up/Down navigates (wrap at edges), Arrow Right expands branch (no-op on leaves), Arrow Left collapses branch (no-op on leaves), Home/End jump to first/last visible, Space/Enter toggles expand on focused branch. View fn calls `view_tree_focused(TREE_TAG, items, theme, style, &focus)` with the live focused id. Invisible Button at scene root keeps the framework's SCXML state surface alive without painting (the binding is keyboard-driven, no visible Button).

Atomic (2) `WidgetA11y::access_node` advertises `AriaRole::Tree` at the root tag so AT clients (`AccessKit` → NVDA / VoiceOver / Orca) recognise the binding's primary content as a hierarchical collection. Per-row `TreeItem` AccessNodes land in a future round once row-level AT events surface (file-tree editor / property-grid 2nd consumer of `hello-tree-view`).

Section (C) Arrow Up/Down navigation cycle through visible rows. Section (G) Home/End jump to first/last visible. Sections (D)/(E)/(F) Arrow Right expands branch, Arrow Left collapses, Space toggles. Section (H) leaves are no-op on expand keys. Section (I) header + footer text rendering. 18-assertion deterministic verification (≥1 PASS in 3 consecutive runs).

publishable_changes_bullets: Atomic (0) AriaRole — `pinion_a11y::AriaRole::Tree` + `AriaRole::TreeItem` variants added. `to_accesskit()` lowers to `Role::Tree` / `Role::TreeItem` (WAI-ARIA 1.2 §5.3.10 / §5.3.11). `aria_name()` returns the canonical literals 'tree' / 'treeitem'. `add_actions_for_role` joins `Tree` to the focus-only container set (parallel to Listbox / RadioGroup / List) + joins `TreeItem` to the commit-class atomic set (parallel to Button / ListBoxOption: Click + Focus).

Atomic (1) substrate — `pinion_widget_paint::tree_view::TreeViewFocus { focused_id: Option<&str> }` + `view_tree_focused(tag, items, theme, style, focus)` interactive entry. `view_tree` (R671 read-only entry) becomes a wrapper that calls `view_tree_focused` with the default empty focus, preserving R671 bit-identical output. Focused row paints with the M3 `SurfaceContainerHighest` token (the canonical M3 list-row focus state-layer); non-focused rows stay transparent.

Atomic (1) layout fix — `view_tree` outer container gains `AlignItems::Stretch` so child rows fill the cross-axis (= horizontal width). Pre-R673 the outer container's default align_items pushed rows to content width which then centered, hiding the depth indent column on the left. Row containers carry `JustifyContent::Start` + `Size { width: Auto, height: row_height }` so the parent stretch extends each row to the full width.

Atomic (1) glyph-column alignment — the expand glyph (▶ / ▼ /  ) is now wrapped in a fixed-width `Container` (style.glyph_size_px = 24 px at M3 defaults) instead of being a direct `TextNode` row child. Leaf rows (NO-BREAK SPACE placeholder, narrow) + branch rows (BLACK TRIANGLE glyphs, wider) now share the same glyph column width → label columns align across the full visible tree. Verified via `scene/layout`: all depth-1 row labels land at the same x coordinate (x=84 at M3 defaults).

Atomic (2) `examples/hello-tree-view` 2nd consumer binding (≈470 LOC). New 18th example crate. Sample file-tree data structure (`FileNode { id, label, expanded, children }`) carried in `Signal<Vec<FileNode>>` + `Signal<Option<String>>` for focused id. `Owner::cache` hook (`use_tree_state`) shares the same instance across view-fn passes. `apply_key` handles WAI-ARIA tree keyboard model: Arrow Up/Down navigates (wrap at edges), Arrow Right expands branch (no-op on leaves), Arrow Left collapses branch (no-op on leaves), Home/End jump to first/last visible, Space/Enter toggles expand on focused branch. View fn calls `view_tree_focused(TREE_TAG, items, theme, style, &focus)` with the live focused id. Invisible Button at scene root keeps the framework's SCXML state surface alive without painting (the binding is keyboard-driven, no visible Button).

Atomic (2) `WidgetA11y::access_node` advertises `AriaRole::Tree` at the root tag so AT clients (`AccessKit` → NVDA / VoiceOver / Orca) recognise the binding's primary content as a hierarchical collection. Per-row `TreeItem` AccessNodes land in a future round once row-level AT events surface (file-tree editor / property-grid 2nd consumer of `hello-tree-view`).

Atomic (3) `tools/demos/r673_tree_view_interactive.py` new demo. Section (A) substrate shape — TreeView root tag + composite row tags + initial visible rows + initial focus highlight on `src`. Section (C) Arrow Up/Down navigation cycle through visible rows. Section (G) Home/End jump to first/last visible. Sections (D)/(E)/(F) Arrow Right expands branch, Arrow Left collapses, Space toggles. Section (H) leaves are no-op on expand keys. Section (I) header + footer text rendering. 18-assertion deterministic verification (≥1 PASS in 3 consecutive runs).

Atomic (3) 13-demo regression sweep PASS bit-identical — todomvc_r660 / double_click_r663 / todomvc_r664 / todomvc_r665 / todomvc_r666 / settings_panel_r667 / settings_panel_r668 / settings_panel_r669 / r670a_carry_clearance / hello_multi_window_r670b / r671_tree_view_inspector / r672_multi_window_race_free / r673_tree_view_interactive (new). All 13 PASS; no flakiness.

R676.decision_summary: R676 §5.16 §5.49 — DevTools highlight overlay + path-stable indexing migration: scene_to_tree_item adopts Browser-DevTools-canonical CSS-selector path scheme (Type[tag-or-nth-of-type]) clearing the R675 architectural debt where banner-on/off shifted tagged button paths under sibling-index counting; find_main_node_at_path + parse_path_segment inverse walker pair lands as the soft-signal resolver; view_main two-pass (raw build via new view_main_raw, then rebuild_with_highlight_at_path wrap of the matching node in a 2 px ColorRole::Error stroked Container); inspector mirrors view_main_raw (unwrapped) to keep tree row paths stable across selection toggle — first visible Phase D editor outliner→viewport bridge complete.
changes_bullets: examples/hello-multi-window/src/main.rs: scene_to_tree_item rewritten to path-stable scheme — Browser-DevTools canonical Type[disambiguator] form. Tagged Container/External use Type[tag] (Container[main_btn]); untagged use Type[nth-of-type] (Text[0]). Root segment is bare Type for untagged singleton roots (Container). 4 new helpers: scene_type_name (exhaustive variant mapping), scene_tag (Container/External tag accessor), scene_root_path_segment, scene_child_path_segment. HashMap<&'static str, usize> per-type counting at recursion.

examples/hello-multi-window/src/main.rs: parse_path_segment + PathDisambiguator enum (Tag<'p> | NthOfType(usize)) — segment parser via usize::from_str disambiguation (tags are identifier-shaped so numeric inside brackets unambiguously denotes nth-of-type). find_child_in_container + find_main_node_at_path<'s> inverse walker pair — descend root by-borrow, return Option<&Scene> with soft-signal None for inspector-only ids (state/main), stale paths, nth-of-type at root, type mismatches, malformed segments.

examples/hello-multi-window/src/main.rs: HIGHLIGHT_BORDER_WIDTH = 2 const. wrap_with_highlight(scene, color) — non-destructive composition: wrap in transparent Container with Border::new(color, 2). rebuild_with_highlight_at_path + descend_and_wrap by-value walker — find matching child via per-type position counting, std::mem::replace swap + transform pattern (canonical Rust idiom for owning-mutating Vec entries through &mut Container).

examples/hello-multi-window/src/main.rs: view_main split into view_main_raw (canonical underlying scene, untouched by highlight) + view_main (raw + overlay rebuild). view_inspector mirrors view_main_raw (NOT view_main) so inspector tree row paths stay stable across selection — DevTools-style separation between underlying tree and overlay paint, mirroring Chrome / Firefox / Safari inspector architecture. Pre-resolution via find_main_node_at_path as soft-signal gate before rebuild_with_highlight_at_path.

R677.decision_summary: R677 §5.16 §5.49 — DevTools property pane (Computed-pane analog): view_inspector restructured into 2-pane Row layout (left=tree, right=property_pane); property_pane_rows field walker emits one row per scene-node field (type/tag/style.fill/style.border/layout.size/children for Container, content/font_size/fg for Text, type+tag for External); find_main_node_at_path 2nd consumer (1st = R676 view_main highlight overlay pre-resolve) tracks the [[abstraction-needs-second-consumer]] Rule-of-Three approach; inspector window resized 280×140 → 480×320 to host the wider layout; soft-fail "(no selection)" placeholder for inspector-only ids and stale paths.
changes_bullets: examples/hello-multi-window/src/main.rs: view_inspector restructured — outer FlexDirection::Row Container with two children: existing view_tree_focused output (tagged inspector_tree, left) + new property_pane container (tagged property_pane, right, flex_grow=1.0). LayoutStyle Row + AlignItems::Stretch for cross-axis fill. R667 flex_grow primitive 2nd application consumer (settings-panel = 1st).

examples/hello-multi-window/src/main.rs: property_pane(main_scene, selected, theme) helper builds the right pane — resolves selected via find_main_node_at_path (R676 2nd consumer), then either renders property_pane_rows field rows or the '(no selection)' placeholder when resolution fails. PROPERTY_PANE_TAG / PROPERTY_PANE_NO_SELECTION_TEXT / PROPERTY_PANE_FONT_PX (16, M3 Body Medium) / PROPERTY_PANE_ROW_GAP_PX (4, M3 Density 0) consts.

examples/hello-multi-window/src/main.rs: property_pane_rows(scene) field walker — universal 'type: <Variant>' row + variant-specific rows. R683.A.decision_summary: R683.A §5.16 §5.41 — runtime window-lifecycle substrate: WidgetView::windows_signal opt-in + WindowSpec Cow/serde lift + AppShell::reconcile_windows diff Effect + CoreShell::remove_window cascade (Owner::detach_child_by_id child-scope detach primitive).
changes_bullets: pinion-shell::WindowSpec — `id: &'static str` → `id: Cow<'static, str>` so dock + tear-off arc can mint runtime ids (`Cow::Owned(format!("torn-panel-{n}"))`) alongside the canonical static literals (`Cow::Borrowed("main")` / `Cow::Borrowed("inspector")`). `#[non_exhaustive]` for future additive fields (position, decorations, parent-window). Derives `PartialEq + Eq + serde::Serialize + serde::Deserialize` so `Signal<Vec<WindowSpec>>` satisfies the `T: Clone + PartialEq + Serialize + DeserializeOwned + 'static` trait bound. `pinion-shell::SizeStrategy` derives `Serialize + Deserialize`. `WindowSpec::main` accepts `impl Into<String>` for title (unchanged); `WindowSpec::new` accepts `impl Into<Cow<'static, str>>` for id so string literals + runtime-generated `String`s both coerce.

pinion-shell::WidgetView — new opt-in `windows_signal() -> Option<Rc<Signal<Vec<WindowSpec>>>>` trait method. Default `None` pins the pre-R683 compile-time-only contract (every single + multi-window binding inherits unchanged). Bindings that need runtime add/drop (dock + tear-off) override returning `Some(memoised_signal)`. AppShell wraps the trait call in `root_owner.run` so the binding impl can reach `Owner::current()` + use `Owner::cache` to memoise the returned signal across shell-side re-entries.

pinion-shell::AppShell — three new fields: `windows_signal: Option<Rc<Signal<Vec<WindowSpec>>>>` (cached signal handle), `reconcile_effect: Option<Effect>` (Effect lifetime anchor — the closure captures `signal_clone + proxy.clone()`, reads `signal.get()` to subscribe, sends `AppEvent::WindowsDirty` to wake the shell on each value-changing emit), `last_known_specs: Rc<RefCell<Vec<WindowSpec>>>` (diff baseline). `WindowSlot.spec_id: &'static str` → `Cow<'static, str>` cascade. `spec_id_to_window_id: HashMap<&'static str, WindowId>` → `HashMap<Cow<'static, str>, WindowId>`. All downstream `spec_id: &str` parameter sites unchanged (Cow's `Deref<Target = str>` covers the read API).

pinion-shell::AppShell::install_reconcile_effect + reconcile_windows — substrate methods. install runs inside `root_owner.run(|| Effect::new(&Owner::current(), move || { signal.get(); proxy.send_event(AppEvent::WindowsDirty); }))`; the closure's eager initial run fires WindowsDirty once + the subsequent reconcile no-ops via the seeded baseline. reconcile diffs new vs old spec id set, drops removed specs (closes winit Window via `WindowSlot` drop releasing `Arc<Window>` + cleans per-window substrate via `ShellCore::remove_window`), adds new specs via existing `resume_spec` helper. Idempotent on identical re-emits (`Vec<WindowSpec>` element-wise PartialEq short-circuit).

changes_bullets: pinion-widget-paint::splitter — new module. `SplitterOrientation::{Horizontal, Vertical}` enum (maps to FlexDirection::{Row, Column}). `SplitterStyle::m3_default(orientation, tag)` sidecar (4-px M3 handle + 0.05/0.95 ratio clamps + tag for InputRouter routing). `view_splitter(left, right, ratio_signal, theme, style, dragging) -> Scene` paint helper builds 3-child Container[tag] (left wrapper flex_grow=ratio, handle fixed-size M3 Outline fill, right wrapper flex_grow=1-ratio) with `handle_fill_for_dragging` lerping toward OnSurface 0.16 on drag. `SplitterExternal::new(orientation).attach_ratio(Rc<Signal<f32>>).attach_bounds(min, max)` builder chain. `wants_pointer_capture = true` so cursor stays pinned past clamp edges. `pointer_move(x_rel, y_rel)` first-call calibrates `SplitterDragStart {cursor_fraction, ratio_at_press}`; subsequent calls compute `clamp(ratio_at_press + (cursor_fraction_now - cursor_fraction_at_press), min, max)` and dispatch `Signal::set` (R26 equality-skip de-dups identical re-emits). PointerUp/PointerCancel via `invoke("send", Text("PointerUp"))` channel clears drag state. Orientation-axis selection: Horizontal uses x_rel, Vertical uses y_rel; cross-axis ignored. ExternalIntrospect surfaces `orientation` / `ratio` / `dragging` / `send` slots for RPC scene/query + scene/invoke.

pinion-widget-paint::dock — new module. `DockPanelStyle::m3_default(tag)` (28-px header height + 0.5 tear-off threshold fraction + 12-px header font). `view_dock_panel(title, content, theme, style) -> Scene` paint helper builds Container[panel_tag] with 2 children: header strip tagged `{panel_tag}#header` (M3 SurfaceContainerHigh fill + TextNode title + 8-px horizontal padding) + content wrapper tagged `{panel_tag}#content` (flex_grow=1, wraps application content). `composite_tag(panel_tag, suffix)` helper for `{tag}#{header|content}` form (mirrors R51.42 InputRouter composite-tag convention). `DockPanelExternal::new(panel_id, threshold_frac)` with `panel_id: Cow<'static, str>` for runtime-generated tear-off ids + threshold matching the style. `wants_pointer_capture = true`. `pointer_move` first-call calibrates `DockDragStart {cursor_x, cursor_y}`; subsequent calls compute L∞ norm `max(|Δx|, |Δy|)` and on first threshold crossing fires single `tear_off` intent (`TEAR_OFF_EVENT = "tear_off"`) with panel_id payload via `pending_intents: RefCell<VecDeque<Intent>>` queue. `fired_for_drag: Cell<bool>` guards against multi-fire from continued drag past threshold (would otherwise push N+1 WindowSpecs per single user drag). PointerUp/PointerCancel clears both drag_start + fired_for_drag. `External::is_dirty` + `drain_intents` wire the intent queue to the framework's per-frame drain. ExternalIntrospect surfaces `panel_id` / `tear_off_threshold_frac` / `dragging` / `tear_off_fired` / `send` slots.

`pinion_shell::ShellCore::apply_paint_for_window(window_id, paint_scene, paint_layout)` 신규 primitive (Hack 3.1 청산) — substrate's `last_paint_layout` mirror + `InputRouter::update_paint_scene` 쓰기 (refresh_hover 신호 포함). `finalize_frame_for_window` 은 `apply_paint_for_window` + `tail()` + `handle_tail()` composition 으로 재설계. 명시적 primitive 이름 도입으로 R684 atomic 3 inline-without-drain 변형이 이제 정당화.

`pinion_shell::ShellCore::compute_paint_scene_pure_for_window(window_id, w, h)` + `compute_paint_scene_pure(w, h)` 신규 primitive (Hack 3.3 청산) — V::view + compute_layout 만, animation tick / immediate-mode tick / scroll-dirty re-run / animation-active redraw flag mutation 없음. 명령적 root_owner.run wrap 은 유지 (Owner::cache slots resolve). 용도: RPC dispatch finalize hook + headless / dry-run paths.

R685.B.decision_summary: DockSurface SSOT enforcement (S1-S4) + DockTopology validation + R684.B Hack 3.2 substrate split — textbook 정직 audit 후속 청산.
changes_bullets: `pinion_widget_paint::splitter::SplitterStyle::tag: &'static str` → `Cow<'static, str>`. `m3_default(orient, tag: impl Into<Cow<'static, str>>)` accepts static literals + dynamic String ids (R686 dock-reorganize prepares). `SplitterStyle` lost `Copy` (Cow::Owned not Copy); `Clone` is cheap. `view_splitter` `.with_tag(style.tag.clone())` call site update.

`view_dock_surface` walker SSOT 재설계 — callback signature `Fn(&str) -> DockPanelHandle` + `Fn(&str, SplitterOrientation) -> DockSplitHandle` → `Fn(&str) -> Scene` + `Fn(&str, f32) -> DockSplitState`. 원캙: `DockPanelStyle` + `SplitterStyle` 는 walker 가 topology 의 panel_id / split_id / orientation 으로 자동 구축 (caller cannot drift); `initial_ratio` 는 topology 의 `Split.ratio` 를 walker 가 callback 로 thread (binding 의 Signal 생성자 seed = topology declared value, no defaults duplication). `DockPanelHandle` 제거, `DockSplitHandle` → `DockSplitState` rename (reactive state only).
`pinion_widget_paint::dock::TopologyError` 열거형 신규 — `DuplicatePanelId` / `DuplicateSplitId` / `InvalidRatio { split_id, ratio }` / `EmptyId`. `core::fmt::Display` + `std::error::Error` impl.

`DockTopology::try_new(root) -> Result<Self, TopologyError>` validation gate — 중복 panel_id / split_id, NaN-or-out-of-[0,1] ratio, empty id 검증. `DockTopology::new` 은 `try_new(...).expect(...)` thin panic wrapper (하드코딩 topology 용). `DockTopology::root` pub field → `pub fn root(&self) -> &DockNode` accessor; 향후 변형 primitive (`swap_leaves`, `split_leaf_into`, `remove_leaf`) 이 유일 단독 변형 path.

`examples/hello-dock-panels-editor` 마이그레이션 — `default_ratio_for_split` helper 제거 (Smell 10 / S1 SSOT 청산). `split_tag_for` helper 제거 (R685 atomic 5d 완 identity fn). 대신 `split_cache_key_for` 만 남김 (Owner::cache `&'static str` lifetime requirement). `for_each_split` binding-local helper — topology Split node walk 으로 create_extra_externals 간소화. `use_split_ratio(cache_key, initial_ratio)` signature 유지 — initial_ratio 는 이제 walker 가 제공 (topology SoT).

R685.C.decision_summary: 3차 textbook audit 후속 — S9-S14 6건 청산 (apply_paint 2-primitive split + compute_paint_scene_pure 통합 + cross-namespace validation + for_each_split substrate + Owner::cache Cow lift + panic style 통일).
changes_bullets: S13: `DockTopology::single` 이 inline `assert!` 대신 `try_new(...).expect(...)` 통과 — `DockTopology::new` 과 일관된 panic shape.

S11: DockTopology validation cross-namespace 충돌 검증 — `validate_node` 가 panel_ids + split_ids 분리 HashSet → 단일 `HashMap<String, NodeKind>` 통합. `TopologyError::IdCollision(String)` variant 신규 (panel_id == split_id 시 InputRouter dispatch 충돌 차단). same-kind 중복은 DuplicatePanelId/DuplicateSplitId, cross-kind는 IdCollision 로 구분.

S14: `DockNode::for_each_split` + `DockTopology::for_each_split` substrate accessor 신규 — depth-first pre-order Split walk. hello-dock-panels-editor binding-local `for_each_split` 헬퍼 제거 (DRY — substrate view_dock_surface_node walk 과 중복).

S10: `ShellCore::compute_paint_scene_pure_internal(Option<&str>, w, h)` 통합 — `compute_paint_scene_pure_for_window` + `compute_paint_scene_pure` 코드 중복 청산 (기존 compute_paint_scene_internal Option<&str> dispatch shape mirror).

S9: `ShellCore::apply_paint_for_window` 2-primitive 분리 — `apply_paint_for_window_with_hover_refresh` (winit paint loop용, refresh_hover synthetic arcs 발화) + `apply_paint_for_window_storage_only` (RPC dispatch용, set_paint_scene_for_window storage-only, hover arcs 안 발화). dispatch_rpc_inner finalize hook이 inline 2-write 대신 명명된 storage_only primitive 사용.

S12: `Owner::cache` / `cache_contains` key `&'static str` → `impl Into<Cow<'static, str>>` lift. CacheKey type `(TypeId, &'static str)` → `(TypeId, Cow<'static, str>)`. cache_get_by_str 비교 `*k == key` → `k.as_ref() == key`. R686 dock-reorganize 가 생성하는 runtime String ids 가 Box::leak 없이 cache slot addressing 가능 — Phase D editor blocker 청산. 정적 literal 은 Cow::Borrowed 무비용 coerce.
