R687.decision_summary: R687 delivers the R686-planned DockSurface drag-to-reorganize substrate: drop-zone geometry, immutable topology mutation primitives, a resolver, and an AI-native DockReorganizeExternal driving reactive topology edits.
changes_bullets: pinion-widget-paint::dock: DockDropZone enum (None/Left/Right/Top/Bottom/Center, non_exhaustive) + dock_drop_zone_for(Rect, f64, f64) pure helper (DOCK_EDGE_ZONE_FRAC=0.25 picture-frame, half-open containment, nearest-edge tiebreak Left>Right>Top>Bottom). Geometry/gesture separation: zone names are spatial, not gesture-baked (deviation from the R686 sketch's SwapLeft naming).

DockTopology mutation primitives, all &self -> Result<DockTopology, TopologyError> (NOT the sketch's Option): swap_leaves / split_leaf_into / remove_leaf; new TopologyError::PanelNotFound + RootRemoval variants; every result flows through the try_new validation gate. SplitInsert uses an Option::take payload (SplitInsertion) so owned Cow ids move into the tree exactly once.

DockReorganizeIntent enum (Swap / SplitInsert with pre-resolved orientation+position) + apply() composing the primitives (SplitInsert = remove_leaf then split_leaf_into, a move). resolve_dock_drop(panel_rects, source, x, y) pure resolver = layout + cursor -> typed gesture.

DockReorganizeExternal (invoke-driven, holds Rc<Signal<DockTopology>>): scene/invoke reorganize applies a gesture + Signal::set -> reactive re-render; query(topology) exposes the live tree as JSON (s2 #7 scene-as-data); split_seq monotonic id minting (reorg-split-N). serde_json promoted from dev-only to a normal dep.

hello-dock-panels-editor wired: use_editor_topology() Signal<DockTopology> via Owner::cache; use_split_ratio lifted to Cow key (runtime reorg-split ids render via Owner::cache); DockReorganizeExternal registered at /dock_reorganize; view fn reads the reactive topology. Design correction: the SEED's non-capturing DockDragOverExternal is incompatible with the InputRouter exclusive capture model (cursor_moved routes only to the captured tag), so resolution is caller-side (AI client has scene/layout) + an invoke-driven external.

R687.A.decision_summary: R687.A audit-clearance: wire the dead geometry resolver into the DockReorganizeExternal so drop-zone geometry is a single Rust SSOT reachable via RPC, instead of speculative pub API forcing every client to re-implement it.
changes_bullets: Audit finding (user-requested textbook review, grep-verified): resolve_dock_drop had ZERO production consumers (only unit tests) and dock_drop_zone_for's only caller was resolve_dock_drop itself -> both dead in the shipped path. The R687 RPC wire (reorganize {source,target,zone}) took a pre-classified zone, bypassing the resolver, so the demo + every AI client had to re-implement the zone geometry (SSOT leak). Violates [[abstraction-needs-second-consumer]] + YAGNI.

Fix: added DockReorganizeExternal invoke(drop, {source, cursor:{x,y}, panels:[{tag,rect}]}) action — caller hands observed scene/layout rects + release cursor, the SUBSTRATE classifies via dock_drop_zone_for + resolves via resolve_dock_drop. Both pub fns now have a real production consumer; geometry is a single Rust SSOT no client re-implements. Drop over no target / the source = Ok(Null) no-op (cancel, not error). parse_json_rect helper added.

Kept the symbolic reorganize {source,target,zone} action as the distinct AI-agent path (panel ids + zone name, no pixels). The two actions serve two first-class AI interaction modes (pixel-observed cursor vs symbol-known target); both exercised by tests + demo.

Demo tools/demos/r686_dock_reorganize.py: deleted the Python _drop_zone replica + _EDGE_FRAC const; sections C-E now drive drop (substrate classifies); section G adds a symbolic reorganize positive + malformed-drop + stale-source rejections. The demo picks cursor coords (centre / left-edge) but never classifies zones.

R688.decision_summary: Runtime external registration substrate: CoreShell::reconcile_externals makes the ExtraExternal set a reactive projection of state so runtime-minted dock splits register routable Externals (clears R687 carry b).
changes_bullets: pinion-core/widget_core.rs: ExtraExternal.tag changed &'static str -> Cow<'static, str>; ExtraExternal::new takes impl Into<Cow<'static, str>> so a binding can register an external under a runtime-generated tag (reorg-split-N) without leaking a static. Static literals stay Cow::Borrowed (no allocation).

pinion-runtime/core_shell.rs: new CoreShell::reconcile_externals() re-runs WidgetCore::create_extra_externals in the root_owner scope, diffs the tag list against the state-scene External children with a steady-state no-op guard, and on change rebuilds preserve-by-tag (surviving tags keep their live instance to retain in-flight state like drag capture and id counters; removed tags drop). Single-External bindings hit the bare-scene no-op path.

R688.A.decision_summary: R688.A audit-clearance: extract a compose_root SSOT helper for the state-scene root shape and replace reconcile_externals' impossible-shape fallback with an unreachable! contract panic.
changes_bullets: pinion-runtime/core_shell.rs: new private CoreShell::compose_root(primary, extra_children) -> Scene is the single source for the root-shape rule (bare Scene::External when no extras, else Scene::Container([primary, ...extras])). Both CoreShell::new (boot) and reconcile_externals (runtime) now assemble through it. Finding 1: pre-R688.A the bare-vs-Container decision plus the verbatim ExternalNode::new(handle).with_tag(tag) wrap were duplicated across the two sites, so a future root-shape change could drift between them.

reconcile_externals: the match arm for a scene root that is neither External nor Container changed from a silent restore-and-bail to an unreachable! contract panic. Finding 2: the root is only ever assembled as External/Container by compose_root, and scene_mut only hands out a borrow for path-level intervene/query (never reshapes the root), so the arm was dead; the R685 Smell-6 convention is a contract panic over a silent fallback (a silent bail would hide the violation by leaving the new surface inert).
reconcile_externals: the explicit new_extras.is_empty() early return was removed because compose_root collapses the empty case to the bare primary, unifying the path (one fewer special-case branch).
+1 test r688_a_reconcile_collapses_to_bare_when_all_extras_removed locking the Container->bare collapse that the removed early return used to cover.

R689.decision_summary: R689 gates CoreShell::reconcile_externals behind a WidgetCore::external_set_is_dynamic() capability flag so static-set bindings (the default) skip the per-frame factory re-run entirely.
changes_bullets: pinion-core: new `WidgetCore::external_set_is_dynamic() -> bool` (default false) declaring whether `create_extra_externals` can return a different tag set over the binding's lifetime.

pinion-runtime: `CoreShell::reconcile_externals` early-returns unless the binding opts in. This eliminates the per-frame `V::create_extra_externals` re-run (N throwaway `Box<dyn External>` allocations AND repeated execution of factory boot-seeding side effects such as `intervene("value", ...)` / `use_theme().set_mode(...)`) for the 26 of 27 bindings with a static external set; only the dock editor reconciles.
hello-dock-panels-editor + the R688 ReconcileFixture test override the flag to true (genuinely runtime-varying tag sets — editor walks `Signal<DockTopology>` to mint `reorg-split-{n}`).
pinion-shell `finalize_frame_for_window` call-site comment corrected to reflect the gate (no longer 'per-frame tag compare' for static bindings).

Audit finding: the per-frame re-run was previously documented in the R688.A SEED as a benign 'tradeoff'; independent grep+read audit showed it also re-executed boot-seeding side effects every frame, making it a self-inflicted smell the project's no-carry rule requires clearing inline.

hello-dialog action buttons (the named 3rd shell-focus-paint consumer) now paint a real Tab focus ring sourced from each ButtonExternal's `focused` slot; the restored trigger rings when focus returns to it on close (the substrate is not dialog-specific)

hello-toolbar replaces its hard-coded group_focused=true with the ToolbarExternal `focused` slot, so the roving cursor's ring shows only while the strip owns shell focus (the R692 deferred gating axis); the stale module-doc deferral comment is corrected

R695.decision_summary: R695 Tooltip widget (WAI-ARIA tooltip, WCAG 1.4.13 hover/focus + dismissible/hoverable/persistent) + scene/hover RPC input primitive + aria-describedby a11y relation, first consumer hello-tooltip
changes_bullets: pinion-a11y: AriaRole::Tooltip (-> accesskit Role::Tooltip, aria_name "tooltip", zero AT actions -- a passive description region) + AccessNode.described_by (aria-describedby) with a with_described_by builder, lowered via accesskit push_described_by so the relation resolves to the tooltip NodeId already in the frame

pinion-rpc: scene/hover input primitive -- DeferredInput::Hover{x,y} + handle_scene_hover (at/path selector, mirror of scene/click) drained by the shell as a bare cursor_moved (no press) so the InputRouter fires the PointerEnter/PointerLeave arc; the pointer-position-only peer to scene/click and the tooltip's primary trigger (rpc_verify gains a hover() wrapper)

pinion-core::widgets::tooltip::TooltipExternal -- a self-contained visibility statechart (hovered/focused/dismissed; visible = (hovered||focused) && !dismissed): PointerEnter/Leave hover (composite #pop sub-tag aware), on_focus_change focus trigger, invoke("dismiss") WCAG dismiss; the dismiss latch clears on the trigger-episode falling edge (leave with no focus, or blur with no hover) so a later hover/focus re-shows it

pinion-widget-paint::tooltip -- view_tooltip M3 elevated/outlined surface (SurfaceContainerHighest + Outline + OnSurface) + TooltipPlacement + anchor_position (flush against the anchor edge, flip-on-overflow vertically, clamp horizontally); the overlay carries the anchor tag + a #pop sub-index so a hover over the tooltip body routes to the same external (WCAG 1.4.13 hoverable contiguity) while staying independently locatable

shell: Escape is now offered to the focused widget's apply_key first (new CoreShell::try_apply_key), falling back to the standalone-app quit only when unhandled AND no modal trap is up -- so the Tooltip WCAG dismiss and the Dialog modal cancel ride one funnel; handle_named_key refactored onto the shared try_apply_key (scroll fallback preserved for non-Escape keys)

examples/hello-tooltip -- two trigger buttons (save = primary external, delete = extra external) each owning a TooltipExternal; save opens below, delete (low + right) flips above + clamps to the right edge; aria-describedby links each trigger to its Tooltip node whose name is enriched from the painted text (SSOT, no hardcoded a11y copy)

R697.decision_summary: R697 — multi-open WAI-ARIA APG Accordion as the 2nd consumer of the R696 Disclosure substrate: N DisclosureExternal sections composed through create_extra_externals with per-header Tab stops + arrow-roving focus, zero new core widget.
changes_bullets: examples/hello-accordion (new crate) — N=3 DisclosureExternal sections via WidgetCore::create_extra_externals (homogeneous-cluster path, same as settings-panel's 6 CheckboxExternal); section 0 = create_external, sections 1-2 = extras, each header tagged accordion_sec_{i}; InputRouter depth-first walk routes per-header clicks independently.

Multi-open is the default (APG): toggling one section never collapses another — no cross-section coordination, no reducer, no new substrate. Single-open exclusive mode = framework-owned mutual exclusion in the RadioGroup mould, deferred to a 2nd consumer per [[abstraction-needs-second-consumer]].

Keyboard model: focusable_tags() enumerates all N headers (each its own Tab stop, unlike RadioGroup's single-tab-stop roving); apply_key routes Space/Enter to KeyboardActivate the focused section and ArrowDown/Up (wrapping) + Home/End to move focus between headers via the R664 pinion_core::focus_request mailbox (drained post-dispatch through FocusManager::focus_set in both the winit and RPC arcs).

WidgetA11y::access_node emits N flat AriaRole::Button nodes, each with aria-expanded (R696 AccessNode::with_expanded), interaction state flags, and focused marking; accessible names come from name-from-contents enrichment of each header summary (no parent container — WAI-ARIA defines no accordion role).
Reuses pinion_widget_paint::disclosure::view_disclosure (R696) bit-identically per section — no paint change; the panel body is present in the scene only while its section is expanded.
tools/demos/r697_accordion.py — RPC E2E proving multi-open independence, per-section click/invoke/intervene, Space+Enter focused-section toggle, and ArrowDown/Up/Home/End focus roving via focus/get.

R702.decision_summary: R702 hello-drawer — modal navigation Drawer, the 2nd consumer of the R693 modal focus-trap substrate, with edge-anchored view_drawer chrome + scrim-click light-dismiss (clears the R693 light-dismiss carry).
changes_bullets: New paint helper crates/pinion-widget-paint/src/drawer.rs: DrawerStyle (M3 nav-drawer tokens + DrawerEdge Left/Right folded into the carrier to keep view_drawer within the 7-arg view_* convention) + view_drawer(scrim_tag, panel_tag, title, items, viewport, theme, style) composing a full-window scrim with a full-height edge-anchored panel. Mirrors view_dialog but edge-anchors instead of centring. Registered mod drawer in lib.rs. 9 unit tests.

New example crate examples/hello-drawer (main.rs + Cargo.toml + build.rs + app.pinion.xml HelloDrawerRenderer); registered in workspace members after hello-dialog. Mirrors hello-dialog's modal pattern: trigger ButtonExternal (primary) + N=3 nav-item ButtonExternals + a click-only scrim ButtonExternal (extras); reactive drawer_open + drawer_active Signals via Owner::cache; modal_scope_request::open(nav_members)/close() drives the R693 focus trap; reducer maps <tag>.click intents to the signals + modal lifecycle. 13 unit tests.

Scrim-click light-dismiss (the R693 carry this round clears): the scrim is registered as a real ButtonExternal at drawer_scrim, so a backdrop click emits drawer_scrim.click and the reducer close_drawer()s without navigating. Reuses ButtonExternal rather than minting a ScrimExternal per [[abstraction-needs-second-consumer]] (the binding omits the scrim from the a11y tree, paints it flat, never lists it in focusable_tags). Dialog keeps the WAI-ARIA modal default (Esc-only) by not binding an External to its scrim; the mechanism is now opt-in per widget.

Three dismissal paths converge on the modal substrate: scrim tap (drawer_scrim.click), Escape (apply_key while trap active), and selecting a destination (drawer_item_<i>.click sets active + closes, the modal nav-drawer convention). Per-header focus trap via modal scope (nav items dynamic-focusable, only the trigger is a static focusable_tag); active destination reflected in a tagged drawer_status TextNode (RPC-readable). WidgetA11y: closed = trigger Button; open = aria-modal Dialog owning N Button children (scrim + trigger omitted), names enriched from paint.

Per-header focus trap via modal scope (nav items dynamic-focusable, only the trigger is a static focusable_tag); active destination reflected in a tagged drawer_status TextNode (RPC-readable). R703.decision_summary: R703 SSOT debt-clearance — lift the duplicated modal scrim primitive + composite-button binding helpers surfaced by the R702 self-audit, before resuming widget breadth.
changes_bullets: Audit finding (user-triggered textbook/SSOT review): R702 introduced two verbatim duplications. (a) The modal scrim backdrop was independently reimplemented in dialog.rs + drawer.rs (the 0x66 alpha, scrim_color() derivation, and absolute-full-window dim-container construction). (b) Four composite-button helpers (button_a11y_state IDENTICAL, read_button_state / read_button_focused / button_scene IDENTICAL) were copied between hello-dialog + hello-drawer. A modal scrim + an a11y mapping are framework primitives; 2 verbatim copies violate SSOT once a 2nd consumer exists.

Scrim lift: new crates/pinion-widget-paint/src/scrim.rs — M3_SCRIM_ALPHA const (SSOT for the 0x66 default), scrim_fill(alpha) (one home for the black-at-alpha derivation), and scrim_backdrop(tag, fill, viewport, flex, align, justify, panel) (the absolute-full-window backdrop construction). DialogStyle/DrawerStyle scrim_alpha defaults + scrim_color() now delegate; view_dialog + view_drawer call scrim_backdrop (dialog centres its panel, drawer pins it edge-anchored full-height). 4 new scrim tests; existing dialog/drawer scene-shape tests unchanged (bit-identical output).

Button-helper lift (SSOT-critical subset): read_button_state, read_button_focused, and button_a11y_state moved into pinion_widget_paint::button (the crate already deps pinion-a11y, so the ButtonState->AccessState mapping can live there). button_a11y_state is now the single home mirroring what the #[widget] derive emits for single-node buttons — an a11y mapping with two copies is an a11y bug waiting to happen. hello-dialog + hello-drawer import them; their local copies + the now-unused WidgetStateName import removed. 2 new button-helper tests.

Principled deferral (documented, not lazy): button_scene (paint-compose convenience baking the M3 filled-tonal palette + hover spring) stays per-example. It is a button PAINT helper at 2 consumers; the precedent for button paint lifts is Rule-of-Three (use_hover_progress lifted at 3 consumers, R686.C), and lifting a styled compose helper at 2 risks baking a style opinion into the substrate. Carry: lift to pinion_widget_paint::button at the 3rd consumer. The SSOT-critical mapping (a11y) and pure introspection were lifted now; the opinionated paint-compose waits for its trigger.

cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features pinion-runtime/vello (-D pedantic): clean (scrim_backdrop at the 7-arg limit; removed unused Rect/WidgetStateName imports).

pinion-rpc: DispatchContext.last_paint_scene + with_last_paint_scene; handle_scene_snapshot from:paint serializes the stored scene when present, falls back to the producer only for never-painted (headless) windows.

R706.decision_summary: R706 root-causes and fixes the fragment-cache direct-draw-after-append rasterization defect
changes_bullets: pinion-runtime paint_adapter.rs: to_vello_cached_inner rewritten so `out` receives appends only; every directly-drawn node (non-cacheable container fill, Box/Text/Scroll/ImmediateMode leaf) encodes into a fresh sub-scene that is then appended, so direct draws are always first in their own scene and never follow an append

root cause: vello 0.6 Encoding::append copies the appended child force-transform/style flags (self.flags = other.flags) and extends the transform stream, so a direct fill/stroke issued after an append re-uses stale encoder state; R705's focus-ring overlay Box stroked right after the cached grid append rendered one grid column off (visible on screen, invisible to scene/snapshot from:paint because the scene carried the correct rect)
pinion-shell app.rs: PINION_SCREENSHOT headless capture switched from to_vello to to_vello_cached so the AI headless pixel view uses the same rasterizer as the live window (producer parity)
pinion-shell headless_screenshot.rs: ignore-gated wgpu smoke test for cached headless overlay placement
tools/demos/r706_focus_ring_pixel.py: authoritative live-window pixel guard (ffmpeg x11grab; asserts the ring sits on the focused day column; skips cleanly without display/ffmpeg/PIL)
verification_bullets: live pixel capture: ring center measured on cell#3 column 0; to_vello_cached buggy path drew column 1, to_vello immune, fix restores column 0
cargo test --workspace 76 suites green; clippy --workspace --all-targets --features pinion-runtime/vello clean; full demo sweep 60/60 pass
carry_forward_bullets: the one-grid-column shift only reproduces against the full live datepicker paint scene, not a hand-built scene; the headless smoke test guards general cached-overlay placement while r706_focus_ring_pixel.py is the faithful live guard

R735.1.decision_summary: R735.1 audit-clearance (user SSOT review): grep+read audit found the select-N-of-M coordinator family duplicated the single-select sibling-deselect loop (4 copies: RadioGroup/DatePicker/ListBox/Table) + the multi-select bitmap snapshot/detect/slot-setter (2 copies: ListBox/Table). New crate-internal widgets::selection substrate is the single source of truth, adopted by all four; the leaf-typed activation predicate stays inline (don't abstract what diverges). Finding 2 (example grid introspect-reader duplication) examined and kept as honest carry: the cursor-movers genuinely diverge on sort-awareness so a shared helper would be a wrong abstraction, and the pure readers are trivial example glue with no clean home.

R738.1.decision_summary: R738.1 audit + user-caught live bug clearance — grabbing the low thumb moved the high thumb; root cause was InputRouter normalizing the captured cursor against the sub-tag (thumb) rect; fixed via a new External::capture_normalize_against_primary opt-in (default false, range slider returns true) after a too-broad global fix broke dock tear-off; + accent border-ring handle visibility + audit smell fixes
changes_bullets: R738.1 audit + live-interaction bug clearance (range slider)
BUG (user-caught, live window): grabbing the low thumb moved the high thumb
Cause: forward_pointer_move normalized the captured cursor vs the sub-tag (thumb) rect
The 18px thumb rect saturated x_rel on any drag so the nearest-thumb pick hit the far thumb
First fix (global primary-rect normalize) broke dock tear-off (sweep caught it) -> reverted
Correct fix: new External::capture_normalize_against_primary() opt-in, default false
Range returns true (value spans track); dock stays false; router honors the per-widget flag
Thumbs stay clickable + focusable hit-targets (full APG); single-tag + dock widgets unaffected
Visibility: white OnAccent thumbs were invisible on the light page; +2px accent border ring
Audit smells: boot() dedup; thumb() takes &Theme; strengthened vertical-pointer unit test
Two router regression tests (opt-in -> track 0.45; default -> sub-tag header 0.25)
Demo: grab a thumb (from_path) + mid-track drag asserts grab-low->low; endpoints had masked the bug
verification_bullets: pinion-runtime +2 unit (capture_normalize opt-in -> track; default -> sub-tag header)
pinion-core range_slider 16 unit (incl. strengthened vertical-pointer inversion)
External gains capture_normalize_against_primary (default false); existing impls inherit it

discrete (stepped) range + aria-valuetext named stops still deferred (R737/R738 carry)
single-slider white handle also low-contrast on light page (catalog-wide axis; range got ring)

R741.decision_summary: R741 button-like pointer-capture — a real-mouse click on a Button/Toggle/Checkbox/Radio is now robust to sub-pixel jitter between press and release. Found via the live hello-image toggle: the binding was correct (RPC scene/click flipped it) but real clicks stray-cancelled because button-likes did not capture the pointer, so a 1px move fired PointerLeave->Idle. Fix = those widgets opt into wants_pointer_capture (suppresses the mid-press leave) plus a new External::cancel_on_release_off_target so a deliberate slide-off-and-release still cancels; the router's pointer_up decides activate (PointerUp, release over) vs cancel (PointerLeave, release off) by full-tag cursor position. Drag widgets keep the commit-anywhere default.

(4) Roving focus ring + lifted grab ring + List/ListItem active-descendant a11y.

R742.3.decision_summary: R742.3 fix composite click-to-focus — genuine framework debt surfaced by the R742 review (not dnd-specific). Click-to-focus only matched the exact hover tag, but a click on a composite widget resolves to a sub-tag (group#i) while single-tab-stop composites (ListBox / RadioGroup / Table / the reorder list) register only the primary tag — so clicking any of them never focused the widget. Masked because every example demo focuses via RPC focus/set, never a native click. New FocusManager::resolve_focusable (exact-first, composite-primary fallback) used by the shell click-to-focus; per-sub-tab composites (accordion-single) still focus the exact sub-tag.

R744.1.decision_summary: R744.1 audit correction (user hack/smell/textbook review): the R744 deferral of the section 5.27 Scene::VirtualList IR variant was wrongly justified as blocked on Scene-clone (a Box<dyn Fn> cannot derive Clone). Corrected the recorded reasons to evidence-first + layout node-synthesis being a new capability, and documented the honest caller-supplied-viewport limitation. No code logic change.

R746.1.decision_summary: R746.1 audit correction (user hack/smell/SSOT review): the BarPhase scrollbar-phase projection in the three virtualization bindings was both redundant (the scrollbar interaction is a reactive Signal the view already auto-subscribes to via .get(), so it drives its own repaints — hello-listbox proves this) and an SSOT violation (it re-declared the canonical ScrollBarState enum and duplicated the decode fragment across 3 bindings). Removed it: the two display-only lists now carry type State = (), hello-virtual-select carries State = Option<usize> (the selection only). No behaviour change.

R746.2.decision_summary: R746.2 audit correction (user re-asked hack/smell/SSOT): VirtualSelectExternal, a selection coordinator, emitted no §5.20 'selected' intent — yet the whole selection family (RadioGroup/ListBox/Table) does, and it is load-bearing (AI observes selection on the intent channel; todomvc drives V::update off it). I had copied SpinButtonExternal, a value-holder — the wrong precedent. Added a pending-intent queue: the interaction path (select via click/invoke) queues a 'selected' intent with the index; the admin restore path (set_selected/clear/intervene) stays silent, matching selection::replace_selection.

R747.1.decision_summary: Fold the R747 sort/filter proxy onto a reactive ViewOrderState single-source-of-truth, matching the ScrollState/use_scroll_state pattern the codebase already uses to share an interactive axis between an External and a view (the scrollbar is a sibling extra-external in the same binding doing exactly this). The first R747 cut computed the order twice (proxy for query, view for paint) and materialized the dataset three times, kept consistent only by both calling row_label — an SSOT smell a user audit surfaced. Now ViewSortFilterExternal is a thin adapter over a shared Rc<ViewOrderState>; order is computed once and read by view + a11y + RPC-query; sort/filter are Signals so the view repaints reactively (no read_state projection). Behaviour identical.

R769.2.decision_summary: Textarea formatting toolbar correctness + AI-first style introspection. The B/I cells lacked a flex container so justify/align were ignored (block top-left); add .flex(Row)+text_align Center to centre the glyphs both axes. The toolbar was gated on field focus at two levels: the example ran try_toolbar_press after a focus guard, and the shell's position_caret_after_press early-returned when nothing was focused, so a toolbar click after the field blurred was dropped -- moved the toolbar router ahead of the guard and made the shell dispatch the press regardless of focus (caret bindings stay no-op when unfocused). Added a style_runs read query (R769.1) exposing applied formatting as JSON, the read peer of apply-style/clear-style, so formatting is RPC-verifiable without a snapshot walk.

R779.1.decision_summary: R779.1 audit-correction (user textbook/SSOT review of the R778-R779 sort-proxy work): lift OrderMemo<K> + source_at_value into a neutral widgets::order_memo module. The order-permutation memo (the cache-invalidation dance) and the source_at introspect decode were a byte-identical-in-shape 2-copy between the 1-D list sort/filter proxy (view_order, R747) and the data-grid column-sort proxy (grid_sort, R778). I had declared-deferred the OrderCache as a perf-cache, but under the cost-no-object textbook standard it is a net-positive SSOT lift: the invalidation logic is the error-prone part and now lives in one tested place (Option<K> subsumes the valid flag). Both proxies delegate; behaviour-preserving. The proxies stay deliberate peers (config + comparator + wire genuinely diverge, pinion has no Model trait), and the with_undo/apply stack-or-direct branch stays bespoke (net-negative to genericize per the R779 rule) — both declared, not silently kept.

R796.1.decision_summary: Granular undo rework (cost-no-object self-review). R796 stored a whole-document EditSnapshot (before+after full text+runs) per command -- O(document) memory per keystroke, a north-star (self-hosted editor) scalability debt. Replace it with a granular TextEditCommand that stores only its single contiguous splice (offset + removed + inserted bytes) plus removed_runs (the run coverage the splice destroyed), reversed via the existing clip/shift run maintenance + normalize. Memory is O(edit), not O(document); a keystroke in plain text stores one byte. text_diff recovers the minimal contiguous edit from before/after; merge is rewritten granular per coalesce group. Behaviour is identical (r796 demo + tests unchanged); 4 new tests pin byte-exact run restoration.

R803.decision_summary: R803 §5.35 — composite-tag ENCODE SSOT lift INVESTIGATED then REJECTED. R802.1's cost-no-object review flagged the {tag}#{sub} encode as lacking an SSOT (~10 sites). A full-repo grep instead found ~100 sites across ~35 files — the signature of an idiom, not a missed abstraction. R806.decision_summary: R806 §5.39 — focus ring is concentric at the top/left framebuffer edge. The R705 overlay outset used a naive saturating_sub that, for a widget flush against the top/left edge (origin < offset, unrepresentable as a negative in the unsigned Rect), clamped the origin to 0 but kept the full +2*offset span, pushing the far edge an extra offset out — a lopsided, oversized ring on every top-flush widget (the user-reported menubar corner defect). The fix clamps the near origin AND shrinks the span by the same amount so the far edge stays at target+offset (concentric; the framebuffer edge clips the lost gap, as a browser does). Investigation note: the reported 15px-thick top edge did not reproduce — live capture shows a faithful uniform 2px stroke; the defect was placement, never stroke width (introspection-from-paint-not-screen).

R806.1.decision_summary: R806.1 §5.39 §5.16 (audit correction) — the reported 16px-thick menubar focus-ring top edge WAS real; my R806 'not reproduced, defect was placement' conclusion was wrong (it leaned on a single mis-measured live capture). Root-caused deterministically from code + an offscreen headless render (no live screenshot): vello's sparse rasteriser floods its top 16px coarse tile when a stroke's coverage reaches the framebuffer y=0 row. It is an upstream vello bug, pre-existing (R805 also placed the ring at y=0), so the R806 concentric-geometry fix was orthogonal and did not touch the visible symptom. Fix: build_focus_ring_box floors the ring TOP origin at TOP_EDGE_INSET (1px) so the top stroke clears the flood row; the left edge does not flood so its origin still floors at 0. Structural fix for the 'only a screenshot finds it' gap: a deterministic headless raster guard (offscreen wgpu readback through the same to_vello_cached the live shell uses) asserts the real injected ring top rasterises <=4px, with a negative control proving a raw y=0 border still floods (and flagging the day the upstream vello fix lands).

R807.decision_summary: R807 §5.16 §5.33 §5.39 (SSOT promotion) — promote the VELLO-001 y=0 top-tile flood workaround from the focus ring alone (R806.1, which silently left the §5.33 AI highlight overlay unfixed despite it being the same transparent-fill bordered box) to a shared pinion_overlay::edge SSOT: clamp_top_off_flood_row + TOP_EDGE_INSET in one module, funnelled through by both build_focus_ring_box and build_highlight_box. The flood-trigger is a transparent-fill bordered overlay flush at the window top; that is exactly the overlay family, so the overlay crate is the correct SSOT scope. A renderer-side stroke clamp was deliberately rejected because it shifts the painted stroke without the scene reflecting it, breaking scene-as-data == screen (the AI-introspection invariant); geometry-inset on a transparent-fill box keeps scene-data byte-faithful to the pixels and leaves no fill gap. Filled widget borders flush at the top do not occur (top-flush borders are x=0, which the flood spares). Self-grep lesson: R806's 3rd-consumer self-grep used the wrong axis (rect-outset) and missed the highlight; the correct axis was edge-stroke overlay.

R808.decision_summary: R808 §5.16 — upgrade Vello 0.6.0->0.9.0 + wgpu 26->29 (peniko 0.5->0.6, kurbo 0.12->0.13), spanning vello's 0.7 stroke-artifact fix / 0.8 wgpu28 / 0.9 wgpu29+perf, then re-verify VELLO-001 (the y=0 top-tile stroke flood). The pure-vello negative-control raster guard still passes on 0.9 — the flood is NOT fixed upstream — so the pinion_overlay::edge inset stays and both overlay guards remain green. The upgrade lands anyway for three versions of fixes + perf + the wgpu29 stack. API migration: paint_adapter push_clip_layer gained a clip_style arg (Fill::NonZero, 4 sites); headless_screenshot adapts to wgpu 29 (Instance::new by-value, InstanceDescriptor.display, DeviceDescriptor.experimental_features, PollType::wait_indefinitely); the forge Vello renderer template handles wgpu 29's get_current_texture returning a CurrentSurfaceTexture status enum instead of Result<_,SurfaceError>, its error enum dropping the SurfaceError From-conversion for a labelled Surface(&'static str) so the success states stay unrepresentable. New upstream limitation VELLO-002: vello 0.9's RenderContext builds its wgpu instance with display:None (upstream TODO), so wgpu 29's GL backend finds no surface-compatible adapter and returns NoCompatibleDevice, breaking the Xvfb + software-GL headless sweep; the sweep now defaults to a real GPU via Vulkan on the host display (sweep_headless.sh PINION_SWEEP_MODE=realgpu), 144/144 green.

all slots read-only: the countdown is timer-driven (tick/show), a raw intervene would desync it (ReadOnly)
snackbar_introspection_extra(tag, timer) helper registers it as an ExtraExternal (mirrors modal_introspection_extra)
hello-snackbar wires it at snackbar_state, resolving the same Owner-cached Rc the view-fn reads (one SSOT)
closes the R725 carry the SnackbarTimer doc itself flagged ("remaining exposed so an AI client can read the countdown")

R810.1.decision_summary: R810.1 §5.38 §5.12 — SSOT cleanup of the R810 introspect (self-audit fix): lift the byte-identical query-only-introspect External boilerplate that ModalIntrospect (R795) and SnackbarIntrospect (R810) each hand-rolled into a generic QueryOnlyIntrospect<S> + QuerySource trait in pinion-core::external. ModalState/SnackbarTimer impl QuerySource; the *Introspect names become type aliases. R810 had copied the pattern wholesale (2nd consumer) instead of lifting it; abstracted at the 2nd consumer because the shape is forced + the AI-introspection thesis guarantees growth + the lift is net-reductive.
changes_bullets: new generic QueryOnlyIntrospect<S> + QuerySource trait in pinion-core::external (the lifted read-only RPC node)
QueryOnlyIntrospect owns the External boilerplate (Rpc-only/no-paint/no-event) + schema-driven read-only intervene
ModalState + SnackbarTimer now impl QuerySource (the per-widget schema + live query); the modal/snackbar-specific part
ModalIntrospect / SnackbarIntrospect are now type aliases = QueryOnlyIntrospect<ModalState> / <SnackbarTimer> (names + ::new preserved)
deletes the two byte-identical hand-rolled External impls (R795 modal + R810 snackbar); ~20 LOC x2 -> one generic
root cause: R810 copied the ModalIntrospect pattern wholesale (2nd consumer) instead of lifting it = undeclared SSOT dup

§5.13 caveat: Event #[non_exhaustive] + per-variant CoordSpace for Gamepad/HID/Pointer3D future slots
§6.3 outputs: view-fn signature changed to fn(&State, &Frame) -> Scene; Frame ZST in v1.0
§6.3 caveat: Frame ZST guarantee (LLVM ABI elision, runtime zero-cost) + read-only purity constraint
§5.8 caveat: dry_run scope bounded to scene + SCE state; non-SCE sim excluded from guarantee
publishable_verification_bullets: Each hedge runtime cost = 0 (non_exhaustive match identical, Frame ZST elided by LLVM, doc-only for §5.8)
Ergonomic tax limited to downstream _ => arms and Frame param slot in source
Game-engine evolution (Mesh/Camera/Light/Gamepad/dt) addable via SemVer minor; no v2 major required
§2 dry_run purity invariant preserved: Frame read-only, §5.8 scope explicit
publishable_carry_forward_bullets: R12 Button widget reuse: migrate to fn(&State, &Frame) -> Scene signature when next widget lands
pinion-core: define Frame struct as #[non_exhaustive] empty ZST with new() constructor
RPC schema doc: explicit open-set kind handling guidance for clients
§5.16 thin RHI: no spec change needed; game-engine evolution still gated on §1 future round

round-15.decision_summary: Round 15: SCE-driven window topology (§5.17 §5.18 new + §5.4 §5.7 §5.10 §5.13 §5.14 caveats)
changes_bullets: §5.17 new: app.scxml declares window topology; SCE Forge emits WindowId/routing/lifecycle
§5.18 new: RPC path optional /window[id]/ prefix; SCE-emit perfect-hash dispatch
§5.4 caveats: SCE Forge role expanded to app-level codegen backbone beyond widget statecharts
§5.7 §5.10 §5.13 §5.14 caveats: window prefix, per-window mode, WindowEvent slot, SCE root scope
Single vs multi-window auto-branches from SCXML state count; no cargo feature flag needed
verification_bullets: Zero-cost single-window: SCXML 1 window state -> minimal emit; no Application/registry code
Zero-cost multi-window: build-time perfect-hash routing; no runtime HashMap lookup
Forward-compat: R14 non_exhaustive Event enum absorbs WindowEvent variants without v2 bump
Hierarchical SCE topology (§5.14) preserved: windows as <parallel> children of app.scxml root
winit multi-window dep cost honestly acknowledged as the one non-eliminable runtime overhead
carry_forward_bullets: app.scxml convention spec: example template + SCE Forge build.rs integration path
pinion-render-core: swapchain-per-window in §5.16 thin RHI implementation
RPC server skeleton (§5.7): path parser short-circuit on absent /window[id]/ prefix
Dock primitive (§5.2 DockArea Container variant) deferred until layout system lands
MCU evolution path (§5.5) preserved: const tables + no allocator dep
